items.title: 〈美股早盤〉美伊和平露曙光 主要指數漲跌互現、美債殖利率下滑
paras: 美股主要指數周二 (11 日) 漲跌互現，市場傳出美國與伊朗接近達成某種安排，有望結束長達六個月的衝突並推動荷姆茲海峽恢復通行，帶動油價回落及美債殖利率下滑。
標普 500 指數與那斯達克指數在輝達等晶片股走強下上揚；美國原油一度跌破每桶 82 美元，緩解能源價格可能推升通膨的疑慮。不過，投資人對美伊能否達成更全面的協議仍保持審慎，並等待周三 (12 日) 公布的消費者物價指數(CPI)。
截稿前，道瓊工業指數漲逾 160 點或近 0.3%，那斯達克綜合指數跌近 60 點或 近 0.2%，標普 500 指數漲 0.02%，費城半導體指數漲 1.0%。台積電 ADR 漲近 0.4%。
美股指數期貨周二小幅走高，美債收復稍早跌幅，主因市場重新燃起美國與伊朗可能達成協議的希望，帶動國際油價回吐大部分漲幅。
截稿前，標普 500 指數期貨上漲 0.2%，那斯達克 100 指數期貨上漲 0.4%；美國 10 年期公債殖利率下滑 1 個基點至 4.69%。布蘭特原油一度明顯走高，隨後漲幅收斂至 0.4%，報每桶約 88 美元。
巴基斯坦國防部長表示，近日釋出的訊號顯示，美國與伊朗已「接近達成某種安排」，提振市場風險偏好。此前，美國總統川普向伊朗提出一系列廣泛的新要求，一度降低外界對雙方達成協議及重新開放荷姆茲海峽的期待。
Partners Group 首席投資策略師 Anastasia Amoroso 表示，投資人必須接受目前無法確定和平協議何時達成，甚至是否會達成的現實，因此應把焦點重新放在真正推動經濟的基本面，也就是企業獲利，而今年企業獲利表現相當亮眼。
除了中東局勢，市場也將關注美國周三 (12 日) 公布的 7 月消費者物價指數(CPI)，尋找 Fed 利率路徑的新線索。上周五公布的經濟數據弱於預期，已降低市場對 Fed 立即升息的押注。《彭博》調查經濟學家的預估中值顯示，7 月 CPI 可能較前月上升 0.1%，扭轉 6 月下降 0.4% 的走勢。
克里夫蘭聯準銀行總裁哈瑪克 (Beth Hammack) 周一仍釋出鷹派訊號，表示 Fed 可能需要多次升息，才能把通膨拉回 2% 目標。
另一方面，大型科技公司的支出熱潮仍有望延續。英特爾 (INTC-US) 將增資規模擴大至 200 億美元，市場認購需求超過 1,000 億美元。此前，輝達 (NVDA-US) 也計劃向多家華爾街金融機構尋求合計 5,000 億美元的融資承諾。
盤前個股方面，Riot Platforms(RIOT-US) 上漲 16%，Anthropic 與這家比特幣挖礦業者簽署價值 91 億美元的資料中心協議；發電設備製造商 Babcock & Wilcox Enterprises(BW-US) 第二季營收遠優於分析師平均預期，激勵股價大漲 36%。
《彭博行業研究》資料顯示，標普 500 成分股第二季獲利可望年增約 32%，延續第一季成長 30% 的強勁表現，未來兩季增幅也預估超過 20%。美國銀行策略師指出，自 1936 年以來，如此強勁且持續的獲利成長僅出現過 10 次。

items.title: 關掉AIS摸黑闖關！800萬桶原油成功穿越荷姆茲海峽
items.title_en: AIS Switched Off: 8 Million Barrels of Oil Successfully Transit Hormuz Strait
paras: 儘管近期船舶遇襲事件頻傳，中東原油仍透過「接駁運輸」持續穿越荷姆茲海峽，成為全球能源市場的重要供應生命線。衛星影像顯示，部分油輪在關閉自動識別系統 (AIS) 的情況下穿越海峽，隨後在外海進行船對船原油轉運，協助抑制戰爭引發的供應衝擊與油價漲勢。
根據歐盟哨兵 2 號 (Sentinel-2) 衛星資料，本周一在阿曼與阿拉伯聯合大公國沿岸一段綿延逾 100 公里的水域，共發現 12 起船舶原油轉運活動。這顯示即使航運安全風險升高，仍有部分油輪持續冒險往返荷姆茲海峽。
《彭博》彙整船舶追蹤資料及 Kpler、Vortexa 數據顯示，自上周六以來，至少 4 艘載有合計 800 萬桶原油的外運超級油輪，在通過荷姆茲海峽後重新出現在追蹤系統中。部分船舶過去便曾從事接駁運輸，其餘油輪則可能直接駛往世界其他地區的煉油廠。
在區域緊張局勢持續之際，這類接駁與外海轉運活動成為全球能源市場的重要支撐。部分時段每天仍有數百萬桶原油成功運出波斯灣，減輕戰爭造成的全球供應缺口，並協助控制油價。
不過，相關運輸並非毫無風險。戰爭期間積極將原油運出荷姆茲海峽的阿聯主要石油公司上周表示，旗下已有 15 艘船舶遇襲；聲明發布後，周末又有另一艘船遭到攻擊。
阿布達比國家石油公司 (ADNOC) 旗下航運部門周二 (11 日) 表示，最近一季獲利顯著成長，主要受惠於為「將阿聯能源輸送至全球」所提供的額外服務，加上運價大幅上漲，也推升公司獲利。
許多成功穿越荷姆茲海峽的船隻沿著阿曼海岸航行，通過時通常獲得美軍協助。然而，持續發生的攻擊讓願意駛入波斯灣的船東仍相當有限，帶動基準航線油輪日租金再次逼近 50 萬美元。
荷姆茲海峽控制權也成為結束美伊戰爭的主要爭議。德黑蘭堅持有權決定哪些船舶可以通行，並希望向船隻收取通行費；美國則持續封鎖伊朗船舶，試圖切斷其運輸流量。
paras_en: Despite recent attacks on ships, Middle East oil continues to transit the Hormuz Strait through 'spot' shipping, becoming a vital lifeline for the global energy market. Satellite images show some tankers turning off their Automatic Identification System (AIS) to transit the strait, followed by ship-to-ship oil transfers at sea to mitigate supply disruptions and price hikes caused by the conflict.

According to data from the European Union's Sentinel-2 satellite, on Monday, a 100-kilometer stretch of water along the coasts of Oman and the United Arab Emirates saw 12 instances of ship-to-ship oil transfers. This shows that even with increased maritime security risks, some tankers continue to take the risk of transiting the Hormuz Strait.

Bloomberg compiled data from ship tracking and Kpler and Vortexa showed that at least four supertankers carrying a total of 8 million barrels of oil have been spotted in the tracking system after transiting the Hormuz Strait since last Saturday. Some of the ships have a history of engaging in spot shipping, while others may be heading directly to refineries in other parts of the world.

In the midst of regional tensions, such spot shipping and offshore transfers have become crucial to supporting the global energy market. Despite the risks, hundreds of thousands of barrels of oil are still being successfully exported from the Persian Gulf every day, alleviating global supply shortages and helping to control oil prices.

However, the related shipping is not without risks. During the war, the main oil company in the UAE, which has been actively shipping oil out of the Hormuz Strait, reported that 15 of its ships have been attacked; another ship was attacked over the weekend.

The Abu Dhabi National Oil Company (ADNOC) said on Tuesday that its shipping arm had seen significant profit growth in the recent quarter, mainly due to additional services provided to 'transport UAE energy to the world' and a sharp increase in shipping rates, which boosted profits.

Many tankers that successfully transit the Hormuz Strait sail along the coast of Oman and receive assistance from the US military during transit. However, the ongoing attacks have limited the number of shipowners willing to sail into the Persian Gulf, driving the charter rate for benchmark tankers to near $5 million per day.

The control of the Hormuz Strait has also become a major point of contention in ending the US-Iran war. Tehran insists on deciding which ships can pass through the strait and wants to charge tolls to vessels; the US continues to block Iranian ships, trying to cut off its shipping flow.

items.title: 電動車賣不動！三星SDI、通用汽車終止合資 35億美元電池廠急轉彎
items.title_en: Samsung SDI, General Motors End Joint Venture for $3.5 Billion Battery Plant
paras: 南韓電池製造商三星 SDI 周二 (11 日) 宣布，將終止與通用汽車 (GM-US) 在美國印第安納州成立的電池合資協議，並買下通用汽車持有的 49.99% 股權。三星 SDI 指出，電動車需求成長不如預期，是雙方調整合作模式的主要原因，原規劃生產電動車電池的工廠，未來可能轉向供應快速成長的儲能系統 (ESS) 市場。
這家投資額達 35 億美元的合資企業名為 SynergyCells，工廠位於印第安納州新卡萊爾，自 2024 年起開始興建。按照原先規劃，該廠電池年產能為 27GWh，預計於 2027 年啟動量產，主要供應通用汽車旗下電動車使用。
三星 SDI 在監管文件中表示，完成股權收購後，將透過全資子公司 SDI-GM Synergy Cells Holdings 經營該座工廠，以因應儲能系統、電動車及其他高科技應用領域的電池需求。不過，合資企業轉為全資持有後，原有投資計畫也將有所調整，具體方案尚未定案，未來將依監管規定進一步公告。
三星 SDI 表示，自合資案宣布以來，市場環境已出現變化，尤其電動車需求成長速度低於預期，因此雙方決定結束合資關係，轉而尋求其他合作形式。《路透》今年稍早曾報導，由於電動車需求疲弱，該座工廠的施工進度已經放緩。
美國去年 9 月取消每輛 7,500 美元的聯邦電動車稅額抵免後，通用汽車及其他車廠相繼縮減電動車生產與投資。雖然業者仍持續製造及銷售電動車，但已降低工廠產量，以配合市場實際需求。川普政府取消電動車獎勵措施，也迫使全球車廠與電池業者重新評估在美國的投資計畫。
儘管結束合資案，三星 SDI 與通用汽車仍將維持策略合作。雙方已另行簽署協議，共同開發可供未來電動車使用的次世代方形電池。今年 3 月，通用汽車與 LG 新能源也宣布，將田納西州另一座電動車電池廠轉型生產儲能系統電池，凸顯業者正加速把產能轉向需求較強勁的 ESS 市場。
paras_en: Samsung SDI announced on Tuesday (11th) that it will terminate its joint venture agreement with General Motors (GM-US) in Indiana, USA, and acquire General Motors' 49.99% stake. Samsung SDI stated that the growth of electric vehicle demand was not as expected, which is the main reason for adjusting the cooperation pattern. The factory originally planned to produce electric vehicle batteries may be converted to supply the rapidly growing energy storage system (ESS) market in the future.

The joint venture, SynergyCells, with an investment of $3.5 billion, is located in New Carlisle, Indiana, and began construction in 2024. According to the original plan, the factory's battery production capacity is 27GWh per year, and it is expected to start mass production in 2027, mainly supplying General Motors' electric vehicles.

Samsung SDI stated in the regulatory filing that after completing the equity acquisition, it will operate the factory through its wholly-owned subsidiary SDI-GM Synergy Cells Holdings to meet the demand for batteries in the energy storage system, electric vehicles, and other high-tech applications. However, after the joint venture becomes a wholly-owned subsidiary, the original investment plan will be adjusted, and the specific plan has not been determined. It will be further announced in accordance with regulatory requirements.

Samsung SDI stated that since the joint venture was announced, the market environment has changed, especially the growth rate of electric vehicle demand has been lower than expected, so the two parties decided to end the joint venture relationship and seek other forms of cooperation. Reuters reported earlier this year that due to weak demand for electric vehicles, the construction progress of the factory has been slowed down.

After the US canceled the $7,500 federal electric vehicle tax credit per vehicle in September last year, General Motors and other manufacturers have successively reduced their electric vehicle production and investment. Although manufacturers continue to manufacture and sell electric vehicles, they have reduced factory production to match actual market demand. The cancellation of electric vehicle incentives by the Trump administration has also forced global manufacturers and battery makers to re-evaluate their investment plans in the US.

Although the joint venture has ended, Samsung SDI and General Motors will still maintain strategic cooperation. The two parties have signed another agreement to jointly develop next-generation square batteries that can be used in future electric vehicles. In March this year, General Motors and LG New Energy announced that they would convert another electric vehicle battery factory in Tennessee to produce energy storage system batteries, highlighting that manufacturers are accelerating the conversion of production capacity to the ESS market with stronger demand.

items.title: 告別通縮日元守160！野村揭5大關鍵讓日銀最快「這時」升息 日股有底氣
items.title_en: Saying Goodbye to the Yen's 30-Year Deflation! Nomura Reveals 5 Key Factors for BOJ to Raise Interest Rates as Early as This Fall
paras: 野村投信策略暨行銷處主管張繼文今 (11) 日於野村台日優選多重資產基金上市記者會指出 5 大關鍵解析，日本經濟告別 30 年通縮，薪資調升與企業改革帶動正循環。野村宏觀團隊預測日元年底前在 155 至 165 區間波動，美日聯手干預跡象明顯；為縮小美日利差，日銀升息時程極可能提早至今年 9 月或 10 月。此外，日股東證指數（TOPIX）具多元產業分布與企業體質改善優勢，長線價值重估潛力強勁。
張繼文指出，首先是，日本經濟正迎來歷史性的轉捩點，正式告別長達 30 年的通縮陰影。隨著薪資調升與企業治理改革，日本經濟正逐步走向健康的正循環，這也促使全球資金重新評估日股的價值。
其次針對市場最關注的日元走勢，張繼文引用野村宏觀團隊預測表示，日元年底前預計將在 155 至 165 的區間內波動。他分析，近期「每日聯手干預」的跡象非常明顯，美國政府已不再僅是暗示，而是透過實際行動表達不希望日元過度貶值，因為這會迫使日本拋售美債以籌集護盤資金，進而影響美國債券市場的穩定。
第三點是貨幣政策，張繼文進一步分析，為了縮小美日利差並緩解日元貶值壓力，日本銀行的升息時程極可能提前。原本市場預期是半年一次的節奏，但目前看來，日本銀行極有機會在今年 9 月或 10 月再度升息。這種政策轉向反映出日方打擊通膨並穩定匯率的強烈決心，對投資人而言，日元匯率的區間底線已逐漸浮現。
第四點，日本市場的投資價值不僅在於匯率，更在於企業體質的改變。張繼文強調，日本政府持續推動的改革正顯著推升企業資本效率與股東回饋。
第五點，相較於估值已高的美股科技巨頭，日股東證指數（TOPIX）擁有金融、消費等多元產業分布，具備強大的價值重估（Value-driven）潛力。在通膨環境下，日本企業開始增加投資與改革，這對日股是長線利多。
paras_en: Nomura Asset Management's Head of Strategy and Marketing, Chang Jiwen, revealed 5 key factors at the Nomura Taiwan-Japan Select Multi-Asset Fund listing press conference on November 11, indicating that Japan's economy has bid farewell to 30 years of deflation, with rising wages and corporate reforms driving a virtuous cycle. Nomura's macro team predicts that the yen will fluctuate within the 155-165 range by the end of the year, with signs of US-Japan joint intervention becoming increasingly apparent; to narrow the US-Japan interest rate gap, the BOJ's interest rate hike schedule is likely to be brought forward to September or October this year. In addition, the Tokyo Stock Price Index (TOPIX) has a diversified industry distribution and corporate quality improvement advantages, with strong long-term revaluation potential.

Chang Jiwen pointed out that Japan's economy is at a historic turning point, formally bidding farewell to the 30-year shadow of deflation. With rising wages and corporate governance reforms, Japan's economy is gradually moving towards a healthy virtuous cycle, which has also prompted global capital to reevaluate the value of the Nikkei.

Secondly, regarding the market's most concerned yen trend, Chang Jiwen cited Nomura's macro team's prediction, stating that the yen is expected to fluctuate within the 155-165 range by the end of the year. He analyzed that recent 'daily joint intervention' signs are very apparent, with the US government no longer just hinting but taking actual action to express its unwillingness for the yen to depreciate excessively, as this would force Japan to sell US bonds to raise funds for intervention, thereby affecting the stability of the US bond market.

Thirdly, currency policy, Chang Jiwen further analyzed that in order to narrow the US-Japan interest rate gap and alleviate the pressure of yen depreciation, the BOJ's interest rate hike schedule is likely to be brought forward. Originally, the market expected a half-yearly rhythm, but it now appears that the BOJ has a high chance of raising interest rates again in September or October this year. This policy shift reflects Japan's strong determination to combat inflation and stabilize the exchange rate, with the yen's exchange rate zone bottom line gradually emerging for investors.

Fourthly, Japan's market investment value is not only about the exchange rate, but also about the change in corporate quality. Chang Jiwen emphasized that the Japanese government's continued reforms have significantly improved corporate capital efficiency and shareholder returns.

Fifthly, compared to the overvalued US tech giants, the Tokyo Stock Price Index (TOPIX) has a diversified industry distribution, including finance and consumer sectors, with strong value-driven potential. In an inflationary environment, Japanese companies have begun to increase investment and reform, which is a long-term positive for the Nikkei.

items.title: 安力-KY上半年仍陷虧損 估下半年營運將轉佳
items.title_en: Anli-KY Still in Loss for the First Half of 2026, Expected to Turn Profit in the Second Half
paras: 散熱模組零件供應商安力 - KY (5223-TW) 在 2026 年 7 月營收以 1.99 億元改寫今年新高，同時，今 (11) 日安力 - KY 並公布最新損益資訊，2026 年上半年安力 - KY 淨損 2592 萬元，每股虧損 0.66 元，估下半年營運轉佳。
安力 - KY 的 7 月營收 1.99 億元，月增 19.98%，年成長 15.38%。公司表示，2026 年 7 月 AI 伺服器應用及無人機相關產品陸續放量出貨，新產品動能持續提升，下半年營運可望優於上半年。
安力 - KY 指出，2026 年上半年仍屬產品結構轉型及新產品量產導入階段。由於既有消費性電子產品需求仍待回溫，新產品尚未完全放量，整體產能利用率及固定成本攤提仍有改善空間；
另一方面，安力 - KY 投入 AI 伺服器應用及無人機精密金屬零組件等新產品研發，導致上半年研究發展費用較去年同期增加約 25%，以強化高階散熱、精密加工及新產品開發能力，致使上半年獲利承受一定壓力。
安力 - KY 隨著新產品布局逐步展現成果，無人機相關精密金屬零組件出貨持續成長，AI 伺服器零組件也配合客戶新平台導入逐步放量，已帶動第二季營收較第一季成長，7 月營收更改寫今年單月新高。
paras_en: Anli-KY (5223-TW), a supplier of heat dissipation module components, reported a revenue of NT$1.99 billion in July 2026, a new high for the year. Anli-KY also announced its latest financial information on July 11, 2026, with a net loss of NT$25.92 million for the first half of 2026, or a loss of NT$0.66 per share, but expected to turn a profit in the second half.

Anli-KY's revenue in July 2026 was NT$1.99 billion, up 19.98% from the previous month and 15.38% from the same period last year. The company stated that AI server applications and unmanned aerial vehicle-related products were gradually shipped out in July 2026, with new product momentum continuing to improve, and the company expects to outperform the first half in the second half.

Anli-KY pointed out that the first half of 2026 was still in the stage of product structure transformation and the introduction of new products. Due to the fact that existing consumer electronics products still need to recover, new products have not yet been fully shipped out, and overall production capacity utilization and fixed costs are still improving.

On the other hand, Anli-KY invested in the research and development of AI server applications and unmanned aerial vehicle precision metal components, resulting in a 25% increase in research and development expenses compared to the same period last year, to strengthen high-end heat dissipation, precision processing, and new product development capabilities, which has put pressure on profits in the first half.

Anli-KY, with the gradual display of new product arrangements, has seen continuous growth in unmanned aerial vehicle-related precision metal components shipments, and AI server components have also been gradually shipped out in line with customer new platform introductions, driving second-quarter revenue growth compared to the first quarter, and July revenue has rewritten this year's single-month high.

items.title: 業外收益進補、產品優化雙利多 信立Q2 EPS 0.22元較去年由虧轉盈
items.title_en: Outside Income Boost and Product Optimization Double Upside: Xinli Q2 EPS 0.22 Yuan Turns Profit from Loss Last Year
paras: 信立化學 (4303-TW) 於今 (11) 日公布 2026 年第 2 季稅後純益為 2,037 萬元、EPS 達 0.22 元，皆分別較上季及去 (2025) 年同期繳出虧轉盈表現。信立表示，主要受惠業外收益認列挹注，加上環保材料需求穩定成長、高附加價值產品出貨增加，除了進一步優化整體產品組合外，也創造營運獲利加分。
信立第 2 季營收達 2.87 億元、季增 26.25％、年增 3.08％，稅後純益為 2,037 萬元。公司除了致力深化垂直整合與跨域應用雙軌並行策略，也從原料配方、表面處理、貼合加工到客製化應用提供完整服務，持續朝低碳、環保與高值化材料方向轉型，其中第 2 季受惠高附加價值產品出貨成長，也挹注單季毛利率達 21％、季增 1.4 個百分比、年增 0.6 個百分比。
另信立今年 7 月營收達 1.08 億元、月增 20.69％、年增 16.88％，也締造單月歷史新高佳績，累計今年 1-7 月合併營收 6.23 億元，較去年同期成長 4.64％，也改寫歷年同期單月新高。
信立強調，主因為 7 月至 9 月通常為公司傳統出貨旺季，主要受惠下游客戶為聖誕節檔期及秋冬新品上市提前備貨，帶動品牌端拉貨力道明顯升溫，挹注 7 月營收創高之關鍵。
展望今年第 3 季，信立表示，將續持審慎樂觀看法，觀察國際運動品牌客戶於今年第 3 季，陸續推出復刻鞋款及節慶檔期新品，有助帶動高附加價值合成皮革材料需求，尤其鏡面、金屬色、仿真皮革及機能性材料具備較高設計感與差異化，可協助品牌客戶提升產品辨識度與市場話題性，並有助於挹注整體營運良好動能。
信立表示，未來將持續以「產銷整合、材料創新、製程優化」為核心策略，深化與國際運動品牌、包袋及高端應用客戶合作，並加速低碳環保材料量產與應用拓展，期望在旺季需求回溫及產品組合優化帶動下，創造整體業務接單表現與訂單能見度。
paras_en: Xinli Chemical (4303-TW) announced on the 11th that its 2026 Q2 after‑tax net profit was NT$20.37 million, with EPS of NT$0.22, both reversing losses from the previous quarter and the same period in 2025. Xinli said the improvement was mainly driven by the recognition of non‑operating income, together with steady growth in demand for eco‑friendly materials and higher‑value product shipments, which not only further optimized its overall product mix but also added to operating profitability.

In Q2, Xinli’s revenue reached NT$287 million, up 26.25% quarter‑over‑quarter and 3.08% year‑over‑year, with after‑tax net profit of NT$20.37 million. The company continues to pursue a dual strategy of deepening vertical integration and cross‑domain applications, offering end‑to‑end services from raw‑material formulation and surface treatment to lamination processing and customized applications, while shifting toward low‑carbon, environmentally friendly, high‑value materials. The quarter benefited from higher‑value product shipments, lifting the gross margin to 21%, a 1.4 percentage‑point increase quarter‑over‑quarter and a 0.6 percentage‑point rise year‑over‑year.

In July, Xinli’s revenue hit NT$108 million, up 20.69% month‑over‑month and 16.88% year‑over‑year, setting a new single‑month historical high. Cumulative revenue for January‑July this year totaled NT$623 million, a 4.64% increase over the same period last year, also breaking previous single‑month records for the same timeframe.

Xinli emphasized that July to September is traditionally its peak shipping season, with downstream customers benefiting from the Christmas period and early stocking for upcoming autumn‑winter product launches. This boosted brand‑side ordering intensity, which was a key factor behind the record July revenue.

Looking ahead to Q3, Xinli said it will maintain a cautiously optimistic outlook, monitoring international sports‑brand customers as they roll out retro‑style shoes and festive‑season new products in the third quarter. This is expected to drive demand for high‑value synthetic leather, especially mirror‑finish, metallic‑tone, faux‑leather and functional materials that offer strong design appeal and differentiation, helping brands enhance product recognizability and market buzz, thereby supporting overall operational momentum.

Xinli stated that it will continue to focus on the core strategies of “integrated production and sales, material innovation, and process optimization,” deepening cooperation with international sports brands, bag makers and high‑end application customers, and accelerating mass production and application expansion of low‑carbon, eco‑friendly materials. The company aims to generate stronger order intake and visibility as peak‑season demand recovers and its product portfolio is further optimized.

items.title: 中國7月汽車內銷年減逾兩成 出口激增88%成車廠救命稻草
items.title_en: China's July Domestic Car Sales Plummet Over 20%, Exports Surge 88% as Lifeline for Automakers
paras: 中國汽車市場 7 月進一步降溫，乘用車零售銷量年減逾兩成，但出口量卻大增 88%，占全國汽車產量比重升至四成以上。在國內價格戰、成本上升及消費信心疲弱的夾擊下，海外市場正成為中國車廠維持規模與獲利的重要支柱。
根據中國乘用車市場信息聯席會 (乘聯會) 周二 (11 日) 公布的資料，中國 7 月乘用車零售銷量為 146 萬輛，較去年同期下滑 20.9%，較 6 月也減少 8.8%。汽車銷量自去年 10 月以來持續下滑，進入下半年後仍未見明顯復甦。
乘聯會指出，7 月原本就是傳統銷售淡季，加上 6 月促銷活動提前透支部分需求，總體經濟環境與消費信心疲弱也進一步壓抑買氣。此外，荷姆茲海峽關閉推升國際油價，中國國內汽油價格今年明顯上漲，導致燃油車持有與使用成本增加。
其中，傳統燃油車銷量年減 41%，成為市場下滑的主要原因。包括純電動車與油電混合車在內的新能源車，零售銷量也年減 3.9% 至 95.1 萬輛，但市場占有率升至創紀錄的 65.1%，顯示消費需求持續由燃油車轉向電動車及油電混合車。
與內需低迷形成鮮明對比的是，中國 7 月汽車出口量年增 88% 至 91.8 萬輛，相當於全國汽車產量的 41%，遠高於去年同期的 21%；新能源車出口量更再度成長逾一倍。
比亞迪 (01211-HK) 是 7 月最大的新能源車出口商，出口 17 萬 3,721 輛，超過排名第二的奇瑞汽車 (09973-HK) 兩倍；比亞迪當月總銷量年增 22% 至約 42 萬輛。特斯拉 (TSLA-US) 上海廠當月交付 9 萬 3,579 輛，其中出口 6 萬 6,330 輛，在中國市場銷售 2 萬 7,249 輛。
與 Stellantis(STLA-US)合作的浙江零跑汽車 (09863-HK) 月銷量則突破 10 萬輛，其中中國零售銷量達 8 萬 3,698 輛，在 A10 等大眾市場車款帶動下，躍居中國第三大暢銷汽車品牌。
不過，出口快速成長仍難完全化解產業獲利壓力。中國汽車業上半年銷售利潤率僅 3.8%，低於上下游製造業平均的 6.5%。原物料成本偏高、供應商付款期限拉長及終端持續折價，均壓縮車廠利潤，迫使業者更加依賴出口成長維持營運規模。
乘聯會預估，中國乘用車市場 8 月仍將處於築底階段，季節性淡季、高油價及消費需求疲弱，將限制市場復甦速度。
paras_en: China's car market continued to cool down in July, with passenger vehicle retail sales plummeting over 20% year-on-year, but exports surged 88% to account for over 40% of the country's total car production. Amidst the price war, rising costs, and weak consumer confidence, overseas markets have become a crucial lifeline for Chinese automakers to maintain scale and profitability.

According to data released by the China Passenger Car Association (CPCA) on Tuesday, China's July passenger vehicle retail sales stood at 1.46 million units, down 20.9% from the same period last year and 8.8% from June. Car sales have been declining since October last year, and the market has yet to show a significant recovery in the second half of the year.

The CPCA noted that July is traditionally a slow sales period, and the early June promotions had already depleted some demand. Additionally, the closure of the Hormuz Strait pushed up international oil prices, leading to a significant increase in gasoline prices in China, which in turn increased the cost of owning and using fuel-powered cars.

Among them, traditional fuel-powered car sales plummeted 41% year-on-year, becoming the main reason for the market's decline. New energy vehicles, including pure electric and hybrid cars, saw retail sales decline 3.9% to 951,000 units, but their market share rose to a record 65.1%, indicating that consumer demand is shifting towards electric and hybrid cars.

In stark contrast to the sluggish domestic market, China's July car exports surged 88% to 918,000 units, accounting for 41% of the country's total car production, far exceeding the 21% share last year; new energy car exports grew more than twice.

BYD (01211.HK) was the largest new energy car exporter in July, shipping out 173,721 units, more than twice the amount of the second-largest exporter, Geely (09973.HK). BYD's total sales in July rose 22% year-on-year to around 420,000 units. Tesla (TSLA.US) delivered 93,579 units in Shanghai in July, with 66,330 units exported and 27,249 units sold in the Chinese market.

Zhejiang Zongteng Automobile (09863.HK), which cooperates with Stellantis (STLA.US), saw its sales break through 100,000 units in July, with 83,698 units sold in China. The A10 and other mass-market models drove the brand to become the third-best-selling car brand in China.

However, the rapid growth in exports still cannot fully alleviate the industry's profitability pressure. China's automotive industry saw a sales profit margin of only 3.8% in the first half of the year, lower than the 6.5% average of the upstream and downstream manufacturing industries. High raw material costs, extended payment terms to suppliers, and continuous price cuts by dealers have all squeezed automakers' profits, forcing them to rely more on export growth to maintain their scale of operations.

The CPCA estimates that China's passenger car market will still be in a bottoming-out phase in August, with seasonal sluggishness, high oil prices, and weak consumer demand limiting the market's recovery speed.

items.title: 無懼政經動盪！全球巨災債券規模衝破650億美元創新高 成高資產配置新寵
items.title_en: Undaunted by Geopolitical Turmoil, Global Catastrophe Bond Market Surpasses $6.5 Billion in New High
paras: 受地緣政治緊張、央行貨幣政策變動及市場波動加劇影響，傳統股票與債券市場的振幅明顯放大。不過，與天然災害風險連結的保險連結證券 (Insurance-Linked Securities，ILS) 近年躍居全球機構投資人與高資產客戶的焦點。其中，具流動性的「巨災債券 (Catastrophe Bonds)」發行量與市場規模均衝上歷史新高，成為資產配置中重要的一環，現在高資產客戶於高雄專區就能買到巨災債券。
根據保險連結證券 (ILS) 專業資產管理機構 Twelve Securis 最新市場資料顯示，截至 2026 年 6 月底，全球巨災債券市場規模已正式突破 650 億美元；今年上半年新發行金額高達 175 億美元，遠超同期到期規模。由於機構投資人需求強勁，多數新發行案件均出現超額募集，顯示市場對此類另類資產的追捧熱度。
Twelve Securis 投資解決方案主管 Vittorio Sangiorgio 指出，巨災債券之所以吸引人，關鍵在於其具備「極低信用風險與政經關聯度」。傳統債券容易受企業違約、經濟衰退或地緣政治影響，例如關稅戰風波，但巨災債券的連結標的為颶風、地震等天然災害風險，該債券不受政經局勢動盪影響。
Sangiorgio 表示，巨災債券的收益率由兩部分組成，一是特殊目的公司 (SPV) 存放資金的無風險利率 (如國債或貨幣市場基金)，二是發起人 (如瑞士再保、慕尼黑再保等再保險巨頭或政府機構) 支付的風險溢價。過去 20 年來，該資產類別的年化平均報酬率約達 7.7% 至 8%，波動度卻僅約 3.7%，遠低於傳統股債。
在交易架構上，巨災債券透過設立獨立的特殊目的公司 (SPV) 進行發行，將投資人資金與發起機構 (Sponsor) 的資產完全隔離。即使承保的保險公司面臨經營危機，也不會牽連 SPV 内的資產，徹底屏除企業信用風險。
針對風險控管，Sangiorgio 說明，巨災債券的風險型態與傳統固定收益商品不同，固收商品每年可能面臨小幅波動或違約，而巨災債券在絕大多數年份均能穩定收息，僅在極少數百年一遇極端巨災發生時才會出現較大損失。為此，專業資產管理團隊會運用大數據與氣象模型，模擬未來 10000 年內可能發生的萬種極端氣候與地質情境，包含颶風、地震及森林火災等，進行精細測算與分散配置，確保整體投資組合獲取合理補償。
以區域分布來看，目前全球巨災債券有高達八至九成集中於美國市場，主要因房產價值高且保險滲透率完整，過去較大天災僅有佛羅里達颶風與加州地震；相比之下，亞洲與歐洲的極端事件衝擊極為有限。例如近期日本熊本發生的 6.8 強震，初步估算保險損失約 20 億至 25 億美元，對全球巨災債券市場的整體影響極微，再次印證成熟策略透過組合分散可有效抗震。
看好巨災債券的防禦特性與收益潛力，康和投顧已正式與目前管理資產約 94 億美元 (巨災債券策略約占全球市場 9.4%) 的 Twelve Securis 合作，擔任其在台行政代理。
康和投顧表示，隨著政府積極打造亞洲資產管理中心，國內高資產客戶對差異化、低相關性商品的需求日益強烈。巨災債券過往主要由大型機構法人參與，未來將透過銀行與證券等通路，陸續引進以巨災債券為核心的投資策略，協助國內高資產客戶在面對多變的全球金融環境時，打造更具韌性與穩定度的資產配置組合。
paras_en: The traditional stock and bond markets have seen a significant increase in volatility due to geopolitical tensions, central bank monetary policy changes, and market fluctuations. However, Insurance-Linked Securities (ILS) have become a focal point for institutional investors and high-net-worth clients in recent years, particularly those linked to natural disaster risks. Catastrophe bonds, a type of ILS with liquidity, have seen a surge in issuance and market size, becoming an essential component of asset allocation. High-net-worth clients in the Kaohsiung area can now purchase catastrophe bonds.

According to market data from Twelve Securis, a professional asset management company specializing in ILS, the global catastrophe bond market has officially surpassed $6.5 billion as of June 2026. The market has seen a significant increase in new issuances, with $17.5 billion in new issuances in the first half of the year, exceeding the same period's maturity size. Due to strong demand from institutional investors, most new issuance cases have seen oversubscription, indicating a high level of enthusiasm for this type of alternative asset.

Twelve Securis' Investment Solutions Manager, Vittorio Sangiorgio, attributes the appeal of catastrophe bonds to their 'extremely low credit risk and geopolitical correlation.' Traditional bonds are vulnerable to corporate defaults, economic downturns, or geopolitical events, such as trade wars, but catastrophe bonds are linked to natural disaster risks, such as hurricanes and earthquakes, and are not affected by geopolitical turmoil.

Sangiorgio notes that the returns on catastrophe bonds are composed of two parts: the risk-free rate of the special purpose vehicle (SPV) holding the funds (e.g., government bonds or money market funds) and the risk premium paid by the sponsor (e.g., reinsurers like Swiss Re or Munich Re or government institutions). Over the past 20 years, the asset class has averaged an annual return of 7.7% to 8%, with a volatility of only 3.7%, significantly lower than traditional stocks and bonds.

In terms of trading structure, catastrophe bonds are issued through the establishment of an independent SPV, which isolates the investor funds from the sponsor's assets. Even if the reinsurer faces operational challenges, it will not affect the assets within the SPV, eliminating corporate credit risk.

Regarding risk management, Sangiorgio explains that catastrophe bonds have a risk profile different from traditional fixed-income products. Fixed-income products may experience small fluctuations or defaults each year, while catastrophe bonds typically generate stable returns in most years, with only significant losses occurring in extreme, once-in-a-century events. To mitigate this risk, professional asset management teams use big data and weather models to simulate 10,000 possible extreme climate and geological scenarios, including hurricanes, earthquakes, and wildfires, to calculate and diversify the investment portfolio.

Geographically, the global catastrophe bond market is highly concentrated in the US market, with around 80-90% of the market, primarily due to high property values and complete insurance penetration. Past major disasters have been limited to Florida hurricanes and California earthquakes. In contrast, extreme events in Asia and Europe have had a limited impact. For example, the recent 6.8-magnitude earthquake in Japan's Kumamoto Prefecture is estimated to have caused around $2-2.5 billion in insurance losses, which has had a negligible impact on the global catastrophe bond market, further demonstrating the effectiveness of diversified strategies.

Cathay Financial Holding has partnered with Twelve Securis, which manages around $940 million in assets, with the catastrophe bond strategy accounting for around 9.4% of the global market. Cathay Financial Holding has become the administrative agent for Twelve Securis in Taiwan.

Cathay Financial Holding believes that the defensive characteristics and potential returns of catastrophe bonds make them an attractive investment option. As the government actively promotes the development of the Asian asset management center, domestic high-net-worth clients are increasingly demanding differentiated, low-correlation products. Catastrophe bonds, previously mainly participated in by large institutional investors, will be introduced through banks and securities channels, helping domestic high-net-worth clients create more resilient and stable asset allocation portfolios in the face of a rapidly changing global financial environment.

items.title: 安力-KY上半年仍陷虧損 估下半年營運將轉佳
items.title_en: Anli-KY Still in Loss for the First Half of 2026, Expected to Turn Profit in the Second Half
paras: 散熱模組零件供應商安力 - KY (5223-TW) 在 2026 年 7 月營收以 1.99 億元改寫今年新高，同時，今 (11) 日安力 - KY 並公布最新損益資訊，2026 年上半年安力 - KY 淨損 2592 萬元，每股虧損 0.66 元，估下半年營運轉佳。
安力 - KY 的 7 月營收 1.99 億元，月增 19.98%，年成長 15.38%。公司表示，2026 年 7 月 AI 伺服器應用及無人機相關產品陸續放量出貨，新產品動能持續提升，下半年營運可望優於上半年。
安力 - KY 指出，2026 年上半年仍屬產品結構轉型及新產品量產導入階段。由於既有消費性電子產品需求仍待回溫，新產品尚未完全放量，整體產能利用率及固定成本攤提仍有改善空間；
另一方面，安力 - KY 投入 AI 伺服器應用及無人機精密金屬零組件等新產品研發，導致上半年研究發展費用較去年同期增加約 25%，以強化高階散熱、精密加工及新產品開發能力，致使上半年獲利承受一定壓力。
安力 - KY 隨著新產品布局逐步展現成果，無人機相關精密金屬零組件出貨持續成長，AI 伺服器零組件也配合客戶新平台導入逐步放量，已帶動第二季營收較第一季成長，7 月營收更改寫今年單月新高。
paras_en: Anli-KY (5223-TW), a supplier of heat dissipation module components, reported a revenue of NT$1.99 billion in July 2026, a new high for the year. Anli-KY also announced its latest financial information on July 11, 2026, with a net loss of NT$25.92 million for the first half of 2026, or a loss of NT$0.66 per share, but expected to turn a profit in the second half.

Anli-KY's revenue in July 2026 was NT$1.99 billion, up 19.98% from the previous month and 15.38% from the same period last year. The company stated that AI server applications and unmanned aerial vehicle-related products were gradually shipped out in July 2026, with new product momentum continuing to improve, and the company expects to outperform the first half in the second half.

Anli-KY pointed out that the first half of 2026 was still in the stage of product structure transformation and the introduction of new products. Due to the fact that existing consumer electronics products still need to recover, new products have not yet been fully shipped out, and overall production capacity utilization and fixed costs are still improving.

On the other hand, Anli-KY invested in the research and development of AI server applications and unmanned aerial vehicle precision metal components, resulting in a 25% increase in research and development expenses compared to the same period last year, to strengthen high-end heat dissipation, precision processing, and new product development capabilities, which has put pressure on profits in the first half.

Anli-KY, with the gradual display of new product arrangements, has seen continuous growth in unmanned aerial vehicle-related precision metal components shipments, and AI server components have also been gradually shipped out in line with customer new platform introductions, driving second-quarter revenue growth compared to the first quarter, and July revenue has rewritten this year's single-month high.

items.title: 業外收益進補、產品優化雙利多 信立Q2 EPS 0.22元較去年由虧轉盈
items.title_en: Outside Income Boost and Product Optimization Double Upside: Xinli Q2 EPS 0.22 Yuan Turns Profit from Loss Last Year
paras: 信立化學 (4303-TW) 於今 (11) 日公布 2026 年第 2 季稅後純益為 2,037 萬元、EPS 達 0.22 元，皆分別較上季及去 (2025) 年同期繳出虧轉盈表現。信立表示，主要受惠業外收益認列挹注，加上環保材料需求穩定成長、高附加價值產品出貨增加，除了進一步優化整體產品組合外，也創造營運獲利加分。
信立第 2 季營收達 2.87 億元、季增 26.25％、年增 3.08％，稅後純益為 2,037 萬元。公司除了致力深化垂直整合與跨域應用雙軌並行策略，也從原料配方、表面處理、貼合加工到客製化應用提供完整服務，持續朝低碳、環保與高值化材料方向轉型，其中第 2 季受惠高附加價值產品出貨成長，也挹注單季毛利率達 21％、季增 1.4 個百分比、年增 0.6 個百分比。
另信立今年 7 月營收達 1.08 億元、月增 20.69％、年增 16.88％，也締造單月歷史新高佳績，累計今年 1-7 月合併營收 6.23 億元，較去年同期成長 4.64％，也改寫歷年同期單月新高。
信立強調，主因為 7 月至 9 月通常為公司傳統出貨旺季，主要受惠下游客戶為聖誕節檔期及秋冬新品上市提前備貨，帶動品牌端拉貨力道明顯升溫，挹注 7 月營收創高之關鍵。
展望今年第 3 季，信立表示，將續持審慎樂觀看法，觀察國際運動品牌客戶於今年第 3 季，陸續推出復刻鞋款及節慶檔期新品，有助帶動高附加價值合成皮革材料需求，尤其鏡面、金屬色、仿真皮革及機能性材料具備較高設計感與差異化，可協助品牌客戶提升產品辨識度與市場話題性，並有助於挹注整體營運良好動能。
信立表示，未來將持續以「產銷整合、材料創新、製程優化」為核心策略，深化與國際運動品牌、包袋及高端應用客戶合作，並加速低碳環保材料量產與應用拓展，期望在旺季需求回溫及產品組合優化帶動下，創造整體業務接單表現與訂單能見度。
paras_en: Xinli Chemical (4303-TW) announced on the 11th that its 2026 Q2 after‑tax net profit was NT$20.37 million, with EPS of NT$0.22, both reversing losses from the previous quarter and the same period in 2025. Xinli said the improvement was mainly driven by the recognition of non‑operating income, together with steady growth in demand for eco‑friendly materials and higher‑value product shipments, which not only further optimized its overall product mix but also added to operating profitability.

In Q2, Xinli’s revenue reached NT$287 million, up 26.25% quarter‑over‑quarter and 3.08% year‑over‑year, with after‑tax net profit of NT$20.37 million. The company continues to pursue a dual strategy of deepening vertical integration and cross‑domain applications, offering end‑to‑end services from raw‑material formulation and surface treatment to lamination processing and customized applications, while shifting toward low‑carbon, environmentally friendly, high‑value materials. The quarter benefited from higher‑value product shipments, lifting the gross margin to 21%, a 1.4 percentage‑point increase quarter‑over‑quarter and a 0.6 percentage‑point rise year‑over‑year.

In July, Xinli’s revenue hit NT$108 million, up 20.69% month‑over‑month and 16.88% year‑over‑year, setting a new single‑month historical high. Cumulative revenue for January‑July this year totaled NT$623 million, a 4.64% increase over the same period last year, also breaking previous single‑month records for the same timeframe.

Xinli emphasized that July to September is traditionally its peak shipping season, with downstream customers benefiting from the Christmas period and early stocking for upcoming autumn‑winter product launches. This boosted brand‑side ordering intensity, which was a key factor behind the record July revenue.

Looking ahead to Q3, Xinli said it will maintain a cautiously optimistic outlook, monitoring international sports‑brand customers as they roll out retro‑style shoes and festive‑season new products in the third quarter. This is expected to drive demand for high‑value synthetic leather, especially mirror‑finish, metallic‑tone, faux‑leather and functional materials that offer strong design appeal and differentiation, helping brands enhance product recognizability and market buzz, thereby supporting overall operational momentum.

Xinli stated that it will continue to focus on the core strategies of “integrated production and sales, material innovation, and process optimization,” deepening cooperation with international sports brands, bag makers and high‑end application customers, and accelerating mass production and application expansion of low‑carbon, eco‑friendly materials. The company aims to generate stronger order intake and visibility as peak‑season demand recovers and its product portfolio is further optimized.

items.title: 【中磊法說會AI摘要】2026/8/11
paras:
一、中磊 (5388-TW) 2026 年第二季及上半年財務與營運詳情



第二季營收與獲利：
第二季營收呈現顯著年成長（YoY），Top-line 成長將近 70%。主要由 WiFi 7 升級、5G FWA、光纖接入與同軸纜線（DOCSIS）等寬頻基礎建設驅動。
毛利率：受記憶體（Memory，包含 DDR 與 eMMC）大幅飆漲衝擊，第二季毛利率下降至 6.9%。
營業利益率（OP Margin）：得益於營收擴大帶動 Overhead 費用率由約 12.5%~13.5% 降至 9%，費用攤提效應展現，營業利益（OP）同比增加約 1.7 億元，OP Margin 守在 3.3%。
每股盈餘（EPS）：第二季單季 EPS 為 1.58 元，Q1 加上 Q2 單季營收季增將近 24%，第二季稅後淨利為 11.7 億元。
上半年累積表現（H1）：
上半年營收年增 58%，營業利益（OP）同步年成長約 70%。受利息支出增加影響（主要為因應記憶體價格飆漲及庫存備料增加之短期融資），上半年歸屬母公司淨利為 1.83 億元。
資產負債與存貨分析：
存貨結構：期末存貨自 198 億元增加至 287 億元（增加約 90 億元）。287 億元中包含：
約 80 億元 為已抵達客戶端的產品。
剩餘 200 億元中，有將近 80 億元（約三成） 為記憶體（Memory）庫存，主因公司採取提早鎖定 Memory 策略以因應持續漲價風險。
營運現金流因備料與預付現貨採購，單季 Operating Cash Flow 為 -34 億元。公司維持長期 Conservative（保守）的淨現金財務架構，具備足夠韌性抵抗供應鏈逆風。

產品線表現（三大領域）



Broadband / Home（占比約 60%）：包含光纖接入、同軸纜線（Triple-DOCSIS）、5G FWA 及家用 WiFi 7 分發。整體市場實質出貨量成長 30%~40%，即使扣除 Memory 價格反應的營收虛胖，實質出貨仍呈高雙位數成長。
Enterprise（占比約 19%）：主因企業級 WiFi 7 解決方案加速鋪路與全面導入帶動。
Infrastructure / AIoT / 影像分析（占比約 21%）：安防監控傳統 Video 轉型為 Video Analytics（影像分析），將 AI 算力下沉至邊緣終端；智慧電網與纜線訊號 Noise（雜訊）即時自修正等 Edge AI 應用成長顯著。

二、 法說會問答完整清單 (Q&A)

Q1：記憶體、PCB 等零組件下半年及 2027 年供應狀況為何？ (群益投顧)

王煒董事長回答：記憶體價格從五個季度前（2025Q1）的低點至今飆漲數倍，（從小於 $0.3/GB 到大於 $3/GB），且部分 Box 的 BOM 成本中記憶體占比已從 小於 10% 暴增至將近 50%。
供應鏈緊缺狀況短期不會立即緩解，預期 2027 年全年供應依然維持緊張，極度考量每一家公司的供應鏈管理與財務資產負債表（Balance Sheet）韌性。
中磊與三星等三大廠及台灣記憶體兩大主要供應商具備長期忠誠合作關係，能確保取得所需 Memory 產能。

Q2：零組件漲價與產品轉嫁價格（Pass-through）交會後，對下半年及 2027 年的營運呈現何種結果？ (群益投顧)

王煒董事長：

運營商客戶因每戶平均收入（ARPU，每戶每月約 $30~$40 美金）遠高於設備一次性成本，為避免流失 Subscriber（重新吸客成本達 $200~$300 美金），對 Memory 漲價轉嫁的價格彈性相對較低（吸納意願較高）。
轉嫁談判雖痛苦但已持續推進。部分漲價轉嫁會擴大分務金額（分母變大），導致毛利率被稀釋（攤薄），但絕對營業利益（OP Dollar）可被守住。公司以保住營業利益率 3.3% 為目標，採取「攻擊性防禦」策略。

Q3：隨著 Agentic AI 導入企業，中磊在 Enterprise 領域除了 WiFi 外是否有線或相關新業務佈局？ (群益投顧)

王煒董事長：

中磊核心強項在於寬帶接取與傳輸（從家庭走到街邊）。Data Center 內部競爭（如 800G 交換器）不符合中磊既有客戶基礎，但 Data Center 的電力限制（全美大型資料中心需 40~50 GW 電力，缺電嚴重）與建置成本，必將促使算力外溢（Mitigation）至中端與邊緣。
中磊一年出貨數千萬個 Box，分散在家庭與街邊。公司策略是保住客戶信任，深耕邊緣計算（Edge Computing），等待大型雲端資料中心投資趨緩或缺電時的外溢紅利。

Q4：接取產品（CPE）與 DAA 基礎設施的次世代 AI 與算力布局細節為何？ (明總經理補充)

明總經理：

CPE 接取設備：下一代主晶片（SoC）均已加入 NPU（約 2 TOPS 算力）。公司正在導入 Agentic AI，將家庭寬頻 CPE 轉型為「家庭助理」；同時開發自主性 AI 網管平台（Quality of Experience），實時自我檢測與修復網路，大幅降低運營商的維修與派員（Technician）成本。
DAA 基礎設施（Infrastructure）：新產品預計於 2027 年年初逐步推推出。由於 DAA 設備部署於街邊，內部嵌入更高算力與 Edge AI 算法，能自動檢測數百萬個街邊節點中損壞的設備或腐蝕斷裂的 Cable，並精準上報網管派員更換，節省數小時至數天的巡檢時間。

Q5：同軸纜線（DOCSIS）與 5G FWA 升級帶來的龐大市場商機與技術門檻為何？ (王煒董事長補充)

王煒董事長：

同軸纜線升級商機：全美約有 6,000 萬至 8,000 萬 Single-Family Household 需從同軸技術提升。重新挖溝鋪設光纖每戶成本高達 $2,000 美金（總計需 $1,000 億美金），而透過 DAA 與邊緣算力升級既有銅纜 / 同軸網路僅需 $200~$300 億美金，且可再延長 10~20 年壽命，蘊含數百億美元寡占商機。
邊緣算力消除雜訊（Noise）：銅纜傳輸會隨距離衰減並放大雜訊。中磊在每一個街邊節點加入大量 AI 算力與演算法，實時清理訊號（Signal-to-Noise Ratio 優化）並動態轉移 Frequency Domain，用算力替代實體光纖鋪設。
5G 毫米波（Millimeter Wave）與 FWA：5G Sub-6GHz 頻譜已被 FWA 設備填滿（Saturated），未來必須依靠毫米波 Beam-forming 與聰明的算力對焦來承載更多流量。中磊蹲點毫米波技術多年，從未放棄。

Q6：中磊如何看待 AI 賣 Token（軟體變現）與硬體升級的關係？ (王煒董事長補充)

王煒董事長：

現階段邊緣 AI 的應用不是直接向消費者賣 Token 賺錢，而是用邊緣計算讓既有網路更聰明、承載更高頻寬、並降低維護成本。
頻寬提升能增加運營商的 ARPU，運營商即願意為中磊的高階 Box 支付更高的價格，進而吸納記憶體漲價成本。若未來邊緣 Box 具備分散式運算能力並能賣 Token 時，將是額外的商業紅利。
免責聲明：本內容為使用 AI 軟體根據各家公司法說會的錄音檔進行 AI 摘要整理，主要是為了協助讀者快速理解各公司法說會之重點，例如：公司財務表現、營運狀況、未來展望以及產業前景，內容僅供參考，並非任何投資建議。如欲了解進一步法說詳情，請查閱鉅亨網相關新聞內容或公司官方公告。

items.title: 〈日電貿法說〉AI用高階MLCC交期拉長 估1-2年內沒有庫存去化問題
items.title_en: Taiwanese Distributor Dayeaton Sees No Inventory Depletion for High-End MLCCs in Next 1-2 Years
paras: 被動元件通路商日電貿 (3090-TW) 今 (11) 日召開法說，總經理于耀國表示，AI 需求強勁且趨勢明確，整體業績預期會越來越好，目前高階 MLCC 交期約 24 至 36 週，在客戶訂單拉長下，預計未來 1 至 2 年內不會有庫存去化問題。
于耀國表示，AI 伺服器與 ASIC 的電壓與電流增加，對被動元件帶來結構性的改變，其中，MLCC、固態與鋁質等三大類電容，在 AI 伺服器與資料中心皆大量使用，整體供需均相對吃緊，預期出貨金額將逐季成長。
于耀國進一步指出，從目前通路商庫存水位來看，約落在 1.5 至 2.5 個月，其中 AI 相關庫存備貨相對較多；消費型產品庫存則較平常少，而目前 AI 用的高階 MLCC 交期較一般消費性產品多出 10 週以上。
產品漲價議題上，于耀國指出，原則上只要原廠調漲就會跟進，且因 AI 用的高階 MLCC 需求強勁，排擠一般規格 MLCC 產能，加上近年原物料、運費等成本上漲，一般規格 MLCC 獲利表現不佳，近期也看到原廠開始針對一般規格產品調漲價格。
以日電貿第二季產品營收占比來看，積層陶瓷電容（MLCC）占 46%，固態電容（SCP）占 31%，電解電容（ECP）占 9%，半導體占 6%，其他占 6%，發光二極體則占 2%。
若以應用領域區分，資訊運算（包含桌上型電腦、筆記型電腦及 AI 伺服器等）占 31%，通訊占 21%，電源占 16%，其他占 16%，代工占 13%，消費性市場占 2%，背光則占 0.81%。
paras_en: Taiwanese distributor Dayeaton (3090-TW) held a conference call today (11th) and its CEO, Yu Yao-Kuo, stated that the demand for AI is strong and the trend is clear, and the overall performance is expected to be better and better. The lead time for high-end MLCCs is around 24 to 36 weeks, and with the extension of customer orders, it is expected that there will be no inventory depletion problem in the next 1 to 2 years.

Yu Yao-Kuo pointed out that the voltage and current of AI servers and ASICs have increased, bringing structural changes to passive components. Among them, MLCC, solid capacitors, and aluminum capacitors are widely used in AI servers and data centers, and the overall supply and demand are relatively tight. It is expected that the shipment value will grow quarter by quarter.

Yu Yao-Kuo further pointed out that, based on the current inventory level of distributors, it is around 1.5 to 2.5 months, and the inventory of AI-related products is relatively more. The inventory of consumer products is relatively less than usual, and the lead time for high-end MLCCs used in AI is more than 10 weeks longer than general consumer products.

Regarding the issue of price increases, Yu Yao-Kuo pointed out that, in principle, as long as the original factory raises the price, it will follow up. And due to the strong demand for high-end MLCCs used in AI, it has squeezed the production capacity of general specifications MLCCs, and with the recent increase in raw materials, transportation costs, etc., the profit performance of general specifications MLCCs has been poor. Recently, the original factory has also started to raise prices for general specification products.

Looking at the product revenue ratio of Dayeaton in the second quarter, MLCC accounted for 46%, solid capacitors accounted for 31%, electrolytic capacitors accounted for 9%, semiconductors accounted for 6%, other products accounted for 6%, and light-emitting diodes accounted for 2%.

If classified by application field, information processing (including desktop computers, laptops, and AI servers, etc.) accounted for 31%, communication accounted for 21%, power accounted for 16%, other accounted for 16%, outsourcing accounted for 13%, consumer market accounted for 2%, and backlight accounted for 0.81%.

items.title: 〈台積電董事會〉攜索尼成立合資公司 2029年生產下世代影像感測器
items.title_en: TSMC and Sony Establish Joint Venture for Next-Generation Image Sensor Production
paras: 索尼半導體解決方案公司 (Sony) 與台積電 (2330-TW)(TSM-US) 今 (11) 日宣布，雙方簽署具法律效力之最終合作協議，於日本熊本縣合志市成立合資公司 Advanced Vision Semiconductor Manufacturing Corporation。此合資公司將採用先進製程技術，作為量產智慧型手機影像感測器所需之研發及製造的核心樞紐，並預計於 2029 年開始量產。
台積電指出，此合資公司將由 Sony 作為單一控制股東，並計畫以索尼集團 (Sony Group) 公司之合併子公司營運。此合資公司之代表董事將由 Sony 指派。
依據最終協議，Sony 計畫透過現金投入及公司分割之資產轉移註方式，挹注合資公司共約 4,650 億日圓 (約新台幣 942.5 億元)；台積電則計畫投資現金約 2,820 億日圓 (約新台幣 571.27 億元)。這些資金的投入將基於市場需求及其他相關業務條件分階段進行。
除了 Sony 與台積電所投入的資金，有關實現此合資公司產能規畫所需要的投資，其考量前提是必須能夠獲得來自日本政府的支持。
在此策略合作夥伴關係下，Sony 將在核心影像感測器技術的研發、產品規劃與設計中擔任領導角色，而此合資公司計畫利用台積公司的先進製程技術與製造專業來推動量產所需的生產研發與製造。
透過此次合作，雙方將加速推動受客戶需求驅動的影像感測器產品進入市場，同時促進技術創新與強化製造能力。此合資公司的設立與交易完成條件皆須取得必要的主管機關核准，並遵循交易常規。
paras_en: Sony Semiconductor Solutions Corporation (Sony) and Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) announced today that they have signed a definitive agreement to establish a joint venture, Advanced Vision Semiconductor Manufacturing Corporation, in Kumamoto Prefecture, Japan.
TSMC stated that the joint venture will be controlled by Sony and operated as a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation.

Under the agreement, Sony plans to invest approximately ¥4,650 billion (approximately NT$942.5 billion) through cash injection and asset transfer, while TSMC plans to invest approximately ¥2,820 billion (approximately NT$571.27 billion) in cash.
In addition to the investments from Sony and TSMC, the joint venture requires government support from the Japanese government to achieve its production plans.

Under this partnership, Sony will lead the development of core image sensor technology, product planning, and design, while the joint venture will leverage TSMC's advanced process technology and manufacturing expertise to drive production research and development and manufacturing.

Through this collaboration, the two companies aim to accelerate the development of image sensor products driven by customer demand, promote technological innovation, and enhance manufacturing capabilities.

items.title: 中鋼(2002)第二季虧轉盈，這次只是反彈還是景氣反轉？
paras: 2026年08月11日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 中鋼營運已經出現谷底修復，但鋼鐵景氣是否真正反轉，仍需要更多時間確認。
中鋼(2002-TW)7月營收297.2億元，累計前7月營收1,977.2億元。
更值得注意的是第二季獲利出現明顯轉折，毛利率由第一季3.33%升至7.95%，營業利益率也由-0.78%回升至4.13%，單季稅後淨利27.97億元，成功由虧轉盈。第二季營收888.4億元、毛利70.7億元、營業利益36.7億元，相較第一季改善幅度明顯。

第二季轉盈，關鍵在利差與出貨同步改善
第二季營運改善主要可以從兩個方向觀察。
第一，利差改善。
2026年第二季後，中鋼陸續調升產品售價，熱軋主力產品4～6月累計每噸調漲約3,600元，以反映前期原料及運費成本上升。
第二，出貨量回升。
中鋼集團第二季合併鋼品銷量約270.7萬噸，相較第一季約253萬噸增加約7%。
雖仍低於原先280萬噸的目標，但出貨規模已較第一季改善。
對固定成本較高的鋼鐵業而言，銷售量增加也有助於固定成本攤提，進一步放大獲利率改善幅度。

但需求端仍偏弱，還看不到全面性鋼鐵景氣復甦
值得注意的是，中鋼獲利改善並不代表終端需求已經全面轉強。
從國內營建活動來看，2026年第一季全台建築物開工總樓地板面積約 540.4萬平方公尺，不僅低於2025年第四季的725.3萬平方公尺，相較2025年第一季的817.7萬平方公尺更減少約 34%，並創下近三年最低水準，目前還看不到營建需求全面轉強的證據。
換句話說，目前比較像是公司本身的獲利條件率先改善，而不是終端需求已經全面進入新一輪上升循環。
(資料來源：營建署)

中鋼營運可能落底，但中國供給壓力還沒有真正消失
供給面則仍須觀察中國鋼市。
根據中國國家統計局統計，2026年上半年中國粗鋼產量約5億噸，年減3.0%，顯示生產端相較去年確實有所收斂。
過去兩年中國鋼材出口高速增加的趨勢在2026年已不再持續惡化，但出口絕對量仍處於歷史高檔。
2026年5、6月出口量仍維持在每月約1,030萬噸左右，遠高於2021～2022年的水準，高出口造成的供給壓力仍未真正解除。
若未來中國粗鋼產量能持續下降，同時出口量也逐步離開目前的歷史高檔，亞洲鋼市供需環境才有機會進一步改善，鋼價也更有條件完成築底。

後續觀察：鋼市復甦仍待需求接棒
中鋼第二季已經由虧轉盈，但目前還不能確認台灣鋼市正式復甦。
後續一方面要觀察中國粗鋼產量與鋼材出口是否持續下降，讓亞洲鋼價的供給壓力進一步減輕；另一方面，也要看到台灣營建、製造業等國內用鋼需求真正回升。
只有中國供給壓力下降，同時國內需求開始轉強，鋼價與出貨改善才更有持續性，也才能確認台灣鋼市真正走出谷底。

items.title: 〈台積電董事會〉Q2配息維持7元 首次提供外資美元股利選擇
items.title_en: TSMC Board Approves Q2 Dividend of NT$7, First-Time Offering US Dollar Dividend Option to Foreign Investors
paras: 台積電 (2330-TW)(TSM-US) 今 (11) 日召開董事會，共拍板四大議案，包括通過第二季財報、核准配發第二季現金股利 7 元、核准資本支出 294 億美元以及與索尼合資成立新公司，其中，第二季現金股利維持 7 元，預計 2026 年 12 月 10 日除息，並於 2027 年 1 月 7 日發放，值得注意的是台積電本次股利發放開始提供外資股東美元股利的選擇。
台積電今日核准 2026 年第二季營業報告書及財務報表，其中第二季合併營收約新台幣 1 兆 2,703 億 8 千萬元，稅後純益約新台幣 7,065 億 6 千萬元，每股盈餘為新台幣 27.25 元。
台積電此次核准配發 2026 年第二季之每股現金股利 7 元，其普通股配息基準日訂定為 2026 年 12 月 16 日，除息交易日則為 2026 年 12 月 10 日。依公司法第一六五條規定，在公司決定分派股息之基準日前五日內，亦即自 2026 年 12 月 12 日起至 12 月 16 日止，停止普通股股票過戶，並於 2027 年 1 月 7 日發放。
此外，因應台灣金管會法規修訂，台積電將自本次股利分派開始提供依「華僑及外國人投資證券管理辦法」投資之外資股東以美元收受現金股利之選擇權利。台積公司在美國紐約證券交易所上市之美國存託憑證之除息交易日及配息基準日皆為 2026 年 12 月 10 日。
台積電為因應基於市場需求預測及技術開發藍圖所制定的長期產能規劃，核准資本預算約美金 294 億 4,250 萬元，內容主要包括建置及升級先進製程產能、建置及升級先進封裝、成熟及 / 或特殊製程產能、廠房興建及廠務設施工程。
台積電此次也核准與索尼半導體解決方案公司 (Sony Semiconductor Solutions Corporation) 合資成立新公司，以研發與製造下一世代影像感測器，以及於不超過 2,820 億日元之額度內認購該合資公司之股份。
paras_en: TSMC (2330-TW)(TSM-US) held a board meeting today, approving four major proposals, including the approval of the second-quarter financial report, the approval of NT$7 per share cash dividend for the second quarter, the approval of capital expenditures of US$29.4 billion, and the establishment of a new company in partnership with Sony. The NT$7 per share cash dividend for the second quarter is expected to be paid on December 10, 2026, and the dividend will be distributed on January 7, 2027. Notably, TSMC will provide foreign shareholders with the option to receive US dollar dividends for the first time.

TSMC approved its 2026 second-quarter operating report and financial statements, with second-quarter consolidated revenue of approximately NT$1.2703 trillion and net income of approximately NT$706.6 billion. Earnings per share were NT$27.25.

TSMC has approved the distribution of NT$7 per share cash dividend for the second quarter, with the record date set for December 16, 2026, and the ex-dividend date set for December 10, 2026. In accordance with Article 165 of the Company Law, the ordinary shares will be suspended from transfer from December 12 to December 16, 2026, and the dividend will be distributed on January 7, 2027.

In addition, in response to the revision of the regulations by the Financial Supervisory Commission, TSMC will provide foreign shareholders with the option to receive US dollar dividends for the first time, starting from this dividend distribution. The ex-dividend date and record date for the American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) listed on the New York Stock Exchange are both December 10, 2026.

TSMC has approved a capital budget of approximately US$29.4 billion, which includes the construction and upgrading of advanced process capacity, the construction and upgrading of advanced packaging, mature and/or special process capacity, and the construction of factory buildings and factory facilities.

TSMC has also approved the establishment of a new company in partnership with Sony Semiconductor Solutions Corporation to develop and manufacture next-generation image sensors, and to purchase shares of the joint venture company within a limit of approximately JPY2.82 trillion.

items.title_en: Jia Ge H1 Net Profit Increases 53% EPS 0.8 NT$
paras: 綜合食品廠佳格食品 (1227-TW) 今 (11) 日公布最新永利資訊，2026 年第二季稅後 2.54 億元，季減 46.77%，年增 1.17 倍，每股純益 0.28 元；2026 年上半年稅後純益 7.31 億元，年增 53.82%，每股純益 0.8 元。公司指出，2026 年下半年聚焦於毛利率改善與產品組合優化。
佳格 2026 年第二 季營收 61.63 億元，毛利率 23.22%，季減 0.22 個百分點，年減 4.1 個百分點，2026 年第二季稅後 2.54 億元，季減 46.77%，年增 1.17 倍。

佳格指出，2026 年上半年整體營運維持穩健成長，雖受國際原物料價格上揚及地緣政治因素影響，葵花油、玉米油及菜籽油等主要食用油原料及塑化包材成本持續攀升，對毛利率帶來壓力；佳格透過持續提升營運效率、強化費用管理及優化產品組合，部份緩和成本上升對本業獲利的影響。
展望下半年，佳格公司表示，將持續聚焦毛利率改善、產品組合優化、價格管理及成本控管，提升高毛利產品占比，持續強化核心營運獲利能力。
佳格表示，面對全球原物料及市場環境持續變動，公司將秉持穩健經營原則，強化產品競爭力、營運韌性及資本使用效率，並堅守食品安全與產品品質的核心承諾，透過精進品質管理與供應鏈把關，以嚴謹標準提供消費者安心、健康且高品質的產品。
paras_en: Jia Ge Food (1227-TW) announced its latest earnings report today (11), with a net profit of NT$2.54 billion in the second quarter of 2026, down 46.77% from the previous quarter and up 1.17 times from the same period last year, with an EPS of NT$0.28. The company's net profit for the first half of 2026 was NT$7.31 billion, up 53.82% from the same period last year, with an EPS of NT$0.8.

Jia Ge's revenue for the second quarter of 2026 was NT$61.63 billion, with a gross margin of 23.22%, down 0.22 percentage points from the previous quarter and down 4.1 percentage points from the same period last year. The company's net profit for the second quarter of 2026 was NT$2.54 billion, down 46.77% from the previous quarter and up 1.17 times from the same period last year.

Jia Ge's revenue for the first half of 2026 was NT$139.34 billion, with a gross margin of 23.34%, down 2.95 percentage points from the same period last year. The company's net profit for the first half of 2026 was NT$7.31 billion, up 53.82% from the same period last year, with an EPS of NT$0.8.

Jia Ge stated that the company's overall operations maintained a stable growth in the first half of 2026, despite being affected by the international price increase of raw materials and geopolitical factors. The company's main edible oil raw materials, such as palm oil, corn oil, and soybean oil, as well as plastic packaging materials, continued to rise in cost, putting pressure on the gross margin. Jia Ge has alleviated the impact of cost increases on its business profitability through continuous improvement of operational efficiency, strengthening of cost management, and optimization of product mix.

Looking ahead to the second half of the year, Jia Ge stated that it will continue to focus on improving gross margin, product mix, price management, and cost control, increasing the proportion of high-margin products, and strengthening its core operating profitability.

Jia Ge stated that in the face of the ongoing changes in global raw materials and market environments, the company will adhere to its prudent operating principles, strengthen its product competitiveness, operational resilience, and capital utilization efficiency, and firmly uphold its core commitment to food safety and product quality. The company will improve its quality management and supply chain management through rigorous standards to provide consumers with safe, healthy, and high-quality products.

items.title: 〈美股早盤〉美伊和平露曙光 主要指數漲跌互現、美債殖利率下滑
paras: 美股主要指數周二 (11 日) 漲跌互現，市場傳出美國與伊朗接近達成某種安排，有望結束長達六個月的衝突並推動荷姆茲海峽恢復通行，帶動油價回落及美債殖利率下滑。
標普 500 指數與那斯達克指數在輝達等晶片股走強下上揚；美國原油一度跌破每桶 82 美元，緩解能源價格可能推升通膨的疑慮。不過，投資人對美伊能否達成更全面的協議仍保持審慎，並等待周三 (12 日) 公布的消費者物價指數(CPI)。
截稿前，道瓊工業指數漲逾 160 點或近 0.3%，那斯達克綜合指數跌近 60 點或 近 0.2%，標普 500 指數漲 0.02%，費城半導體指數漲 1.0%。台積電 ADR 漲近 0.4%。
美股指數期貨周二小幅走高，美債收復稍早跌幅，主因市場重新燃起美國與伊朗可能達成協議的希望，帶動國際油價回吐大部分漲幅。
截稿前，標普 500 指數期貨上漲 0.2%，那斯達克 100 指數期貨上漲 0.4%；美國 10 年期公債殖利率下滑 1 個基點至 4.69%。布蘭特原油一度明顯走高，隨後漲幅收斂至 0.4%，報每桶約 88 美元。
巴基斯坦國防部長表示，近日釋出的訊號顯示，美國與伊朗已「接近達成某種安排」，提振市場風險偏好。此前，美國總統川普向伊朗提出一系列廣泛的新要求，一度降低外界對雙方達成協議及重新開放荷姆茲海峽的期待。
Partners Group 首席投資策略師 Anastasia Amoroso 表示，投資人必須接受目前無法確定和平協議何時達成，甚至是否會達成的現實，因此應把焦點重新放在真正推動經濟的基本面，也就是企業獲利，而今年企業獲利表現相當亮眼。
除了中東局勢，市場也將關注美國周三 (12 日) 公布的 7 月消費者物價指數(CPI)，尋找 Fed 利率路徑的新線索。上周五公布的經濟數據弱於預期，已降低市場對 Fed 立即升息的押注。《彭博》調查經濟學家的預估中值顯示，7 月 CPI 可能較前月上升 0.1%，扭轉 6 月下降 0.4% 的走勢。
克里夫蘭聯準銀行總裁哈瑪克 (Beth Hammack) 周一仍釋出鷹派訊號，表示 Fed 可能需要多次升息，才能把通膨拉回 2% 目標。
另一方面，大型科技公司的支出熱潮仍有望延續。英特爾 (INTC-US) 將增資規模擴大至 200 億美元，市場認購需求超過 1,000 億美元。此前，輝達 (NVDA-US) 也計劃向多家華爾街金融機構尋求合計 5,000 億美元的融資承諾。
盤前個股方面，Riot Platforms(RIOT-US) 上漲 16%，Anthropic 與這家比特幣挖礦業者簽署價值 91 億美元的資料中心協議；發電設備製造商 Babcock & Wilcox Enterprises(BW-US) 第二季營收遠優於分析師平均預期，激勵股價大漲 36%。
《彭博行業研究》資料顯示，標普 500 成分股第二季獲利可望年增約 32%，延續第一季成長 30% 的強勁表現，未來兩季增幅也預估超過 20%。美國銀行策略師指出，自 1936 年以來，如此強勁且持續的獲利成長僅出現過 10 次。

items.title: 電動車賣不動！三星SDI、通用汽車終止合資 35億美元電池廠急轉彎
items.title_en: Samsung SDI, General Motors End Joint Venture for $3.5 Billion Battery Plant
paras: 南韓電池製造商三星 SDI 周二 (11 日) 宣布，將終止與通用汽車 (GM-US) 在美國印第安納州成立的電池合資協議，並買下通用汽車持有的 49.99% 股權。三星 SDI 指出，電動車需求成長不如預期，是雙方調整合作模式的主要原因，原規劃生產電動車電池的工廠，未來可能轉向供應快速成長的儲能系統 (ESS) 市場。
這家投資額達 35 億美元的合資企業名為 SynergyCells，工廠位於印第安納州新卡萊爾，自 2024 年起開始興建。按照原先規劃，該廠電池年產能為 27GWh，預計於 2027 年啟動量產，主要供應通用汽車旗下電動車使用。
三星 SDI 在監管文件中表示，完成股權收購後，將透過全資子公司 SDI-GM Synergy Cells Holdings 經營該座工廠，以因應儲能系統、電動車及其他高科技應用領域的電池需求。不過，合資企業轉為全資持有後，原有投資計畫也將有所調整，具體方案尚未定案，未來將依監管規定進一步公告。
三星 SDI 表示，自合資案宣布以來，市場環境已出現變化，尤其電動車需求成長速度低於預期，因此雙方決定結束合資關係，轉而尋求其他合作形式。《路透》今年稍早曾報導，由於電動車需求疲弱，該座工廠的施工進度已經放緩。
美國去年 9 月取消每輛 7,500 美元的聯邦電動車稅額抵免後，通用汽車及其他車廠相繼縮減電動車生產與投資。雖然業者仍持續製造及銷售電動車，但已降低工廠產量，以配合市場實際需求。川普政府取消電動車獎勵措施，也迫使全球車廠與電池業者重新評估在美國的投資計畫。
儘管結束合資案，三星 SDI 與通用汽車仍將維持策略合作。雙方已另行簽署協議，共同開發可供未來電動車使用的次世代方形電池。今年 3 月，通用汽車與 LG 新能源也宣布，將田納西州另一座電動車電池廠轉型生產儲能系統電池，凸顯業者正加速把產能轉向需求較強勁的 ESS 市場。
paras_en: Samsung SDI announced on Tuesday (11th) that it will terminate its joint venture agreement with General Motors (GM-US) in Indiana, USA, and acquire General Motors' 49.99% stake. Samsung SDI stated that the growth of electric vehicle demand was not as expected, which is the main reason for adjusting the cooperation pattern. The factory originally planned to produce electric vehicle batteries may be converted to supply the rapidly growing energy storage system (ESS) market in the future.

The joint venture, SynergyCells, with an investment of $3.5 billion, is located in New Carlisle, Indiana, and began construction in 2024. According to the original plan, the factory's battery production capacity is 27GWh per year, and it is expected to start mass production in 2027, mainly supplying General Motors' electric vehicles.

Samsung SDI stated in the regulatory filing that after completing the equity acquisition, it will operate the factory through its wholly-owned subsidiary SDI-GM Synergy Cells Holdings to meet the demand for batteries in the energy storage system, electric vehicles, and other high-tech applications. However, after the joint venture becomes a wholly-owned subsidiary, the original investment plan will be adjusted, and the specific plan has not been determined. It will be further announced in accordance with regulatory requirements.

Samsung SDI stated that since the joint venture was announced, the market environment has changed, especially the growth rate of electric vehicle demand has been lower than expected, so the two parties decided to end the joint venture relationship and seek other forms of cooperation. Reuters reported earlier this year that due to weak demand for electric vehicles, the construction progress of the factory has been slowed down.

After the US canceled the $7,500 federal electric vehicle tax credit per vehicle in September last year, General Motors and other manufacturers have successively reduced their electric vehicle production and investment. Although manufacturers continue to manufacture and sell electric vehicles, they have reduced factory production to match actual market demand. The cancellation of electric vehicle incentives by the Trump administration has also forced global manufacturers and battery makers to re-evaluate their investment plans in the US.

Although the joint venture has ended, Samsung SDI and General Motors will still maintain strategic cooperation. The two parties have signed another agreement to jointly develop next-generation square batteries that can be used in future electric vehicles. In March this year, General Motors and LG New Energy announced that they would convert another electric vehicle battery factory in Tennessee to produce energy storage system batteries, highlighting that manufacturers are accelerating the conversion of production capacity to the ESS market with stronger demand.

items.title: 中國7月汽車內銷年減逾兩成 出口激增88%成車廠救命稻草
items.title_en: China's July Domestic Car Sales Plummet Over 20%, Exports Surge 88% as Lifeline for Automakers
paras: 中國汽車市場 7 月進一步降溫，乘用車零售銷量年減逾兩成，但出口量卻大增 88%，占全國汽車產量比重升至四成以上。在國內價格戰、成本上升及消費信心疲弱的夾擊下，海外市場正成為中國車廠維持規模與獲利的重要支柱。
根據中國乘用車市場信息聯席會 (乘聯會) 周二 (11 日) 公布的資料，中國 7 月乘用車零售銷量為 146 萬輛，較去年同期下滑 20.9%，較 6 月也減少 8.8%。汽車銷量自去年 10 月以來持續下滑，進入下半年後仍未見明顯復甦。
乘聯會指出，7 月原本就是傳統銷售淡季，加上 6 月促銷活動提前透支部分需求，總體經濟環境與消費信心疲弱也進一步壓抑買氣。此外，荷姆茲海峽關閉推升國際油價，中國國內汽油價格今年明顯上漲，導致燃油車持有與使用成本增加。
其中，傳統燃油車銷量年減 41%，成為市場下滑的主要原因。包括純電動車與油電混合車在內的新能源車，零售銷量也年減 3.9% 至 95.1 萬輛，但市場占有率升至創紀錄的 65.1%，顯示消費需求持續由燃油車轉向電動車及油電混合車。
與內需低迷形成鮮明對比的是，中國 7 月汽車出口量年增 88% 至 91.8 萬輛，相當於全國汽車產量的 41%，遠高於去年同期的 21%；新能源車出口量更再度成長逾一倍。
比亞迪 (01211-HK) 是 7 月最大的新能源車出口商，出口 17 萬 3,721 輛，超過排名第二的奇瑞汽車 (09973-HK) 兩倍；比亞迪當月總銷量年增 22% 至約 42 萬輛。特斯拉 (TSLA-US) 上海廠當月交付 9 萬 3,579 輛，其中出口 6 萬 6,330 輛，在中國市場銷售 2 萬 7,249 輛。
與 Stellantis(STLA-US)合作的浙江零跑汽車 (09863-HK) 月銷量則突破 10 萬輛，其中中國零售銷量達 8 萬 3,698 輛，在 A10 等大眾市場車款帶動下，躍居中國第三大暢銷汽車品牌。
不過，出口快速成長仍難完全化解產業獲利壓力。中國汽車業上半年銷售利潤率僅 3.8%，低於上下游製造業平均的 6.5%。原物料成本偏高、供應商付款期限拉長及終端持續折價，均壓縮車廠利潤，迫使業者更加依賴出口成長維持營運規模。
乘聯會預估，中國乘用車市場 8 月仍將處於築底階段，季節性淡季、高油價及消費需求疲弱，將限制市場復甦速度。
paras_en: China's car market continued to cool down in July, with passenger vehicle retail sales plummeting over 20% year-on-year, but exports surged 88% to account for over 40% of the country's total car production. Amidst the price war, rising costs, and weak consumer confidence, overseas markets have become a crucial lifeline for Chinese automakers to maintain scale and profitability.

According to data released by the China Passenger Car Association (CPCA) on Tuesday, China's July passenger vehicle retail sales stood at 1.46 million units, down 20.9% from the same period last year and 8.8% from June. Car sales have been declining since October last year, and the market has yet to show a significant recovery in the second half of the year.

The CPCA noted that July is traditionally a slow sales period, and the early June promotions had already depleted some demand. Additionally, the closure of the Hormuz Strait pushed up international oil prices, leading to a significant increase in gasoline prices in China, which in turn increased the cost of owning and using fuel-powered cars.

Among them, traditional fuel-powered car sales plummeted 41% year-on-year, becoming the main reason for the market's decline. New energy vehicles, including pure electric and hybrid cars, saw retail sales decline 3.9% to 951,000 units, but their market share rose to a record 65.1%, indicating that consumer demand is shifting towards electric and hybrid cars.

In stark contrast to the sluggish domestic market, China's July car exports surged 88% to 918,000 units, accounting for 41% of the country's total car production, far exceeding the 21% share last year; new energy car exports grew more than twice.

BYD (01211.HK) was the largest new energy car exporter in July, shipping out 173,721 units, more than twice the amount of the second-largest exporter, Geely (09973.HK). BYD's total sales in July rose 22% year-on-year to around 420,000 units. Tesla (TSLA.US) delivered 93,579 units in Shanghai in July, with 66,330 units exported and 27,249 units sold in the Chinese market.

Zhejiang Zongteng Automobile (09863.HK), which cooperates with Stellantis (STLA.US), saw its sales break through 100,000 units in July, with 83,698 units sold in China. The A10 and other mass-market models drove the brand to become the third-best-selling car brand in China.

However, the rapid growth in exports still cannot fully alleviate the industry's profitability pressure. China's automotive industry saw a sales profit margin of only 3.8% in the first half of the year, lower than the 6.5% average of the upstream and downstream manufacturing industries. High raw material costs, extended payment terms to suppliers, and continuous price cuts by dealers have all squeezed automakers' profits, forcing them to rely more on export growth to maintain their scale of operations.

The CPCA estimates that China's passenger car market will still be in a bottoming-out phase in August, with seasonal sluggishness, high oil prices, and weak consumer demand limiting the market's recovery speed.

items.title: 〈台積電董事會〉攜索尼成立合資公司 2029年生產下世代影像感測器
items.title_en: TSMC and Sony Establish Joint Venture for Next-Generation Image Sensor Production
paras: 索尼半導體解決方案公司 (Sony) 與台積電 (2330-TW)(TSM-US) 今 (11) 日宣布，雙方簽署具法律效力之最終合作協議，於日本熊本縣合志市成立合資公司 Advanced Vision Semiconductor Manufacturing Corporation。此合資公司將採用先進製程技術，作為量產智慧型手機影像感測器所需之研發及製造的核心樞紐，並預計於 2029 年開始量產。
台積電指出，此合資公司將由 Sony 作為單一控制股東，並計畫以索尼集團 (Sony Group) 公司之合併子公司營運。此合資公司之代表董事將由 Sony 指派。
依據最終協議，Sony 計畫透過現金投入及公司分割之資產轉移註方式，挹注合資公司共約 4,650 億日圓 (約新台幣 942.5 億元)；台積電則計畫投資現金約 2,820 億日圓 (約新台幣 571.27 億元)。這些資金的投入將基於市場需求及其他相關業務條件分階段進行。
除了 Sony 與台積電所投入的資金，有關實現此合資公司產能規畫所需要的投資，其考量前提是必須能夠獲得來自日本政府的支持。
在此策略合作夥伴關係下，Sony 將在核心影像感測器技術的研發、產品規劃與設計中擔任領導角色，而此合資公司計畫利用台積公司的先進製程技術與製造專業來推動量產所需的生產研發與製造。
透過此次合作，雙方將加速推動受客戶需求驅動的影像感測器產品進入市場，同時促進技術創新與強化製造能力。此合資公司的設立與交易完成條件皆須取得必要的主管機關核准，並遵循交易常規。
paras_en: Sony Semiconductor Solutions Corporation (Sony) and Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) announced today that they have signed a definitive agreement to establish a joint venture, Advanced Vision Semiconductor Manufacturing Corporation, in Kumamoto Prefecture, Japan.
TSMC stated that the joint venture will be controlled by Sony and operated as a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation.

Under the agreement, Sony plans to invest approximately ¥4,650 billion (approximately NT$942.5 billion) through cash injection and asset transfer, while TSMC plans to invest approximately ¥2,820 billion (approximately NT$571.27 billion) in cash.
In addition to the investments from Sony and TSMC, the joint venture requires government support from the Japanese government to achieve its production plans.

Under this partnership, Sony will lead the development of core image sensor technology, product planning, and design, while the joint venture will leverage TSMC's advanced process technology and manufacturing expertise to drive production research and development and manufacturing.

Through this collaboration, the two companies aim to accelerate the development of image sensor products driven by customer demand, promote technological innovation, and enhance manufacturing capabilities.

items.title: 〈台積電董事會〉Q2配息維持7元 首次提供外資美元股利選擇
items.title_en: TSMC Board Approves Q2 Dividend of NT$7, First-Time Offering US Dollar Dividend Option to Foreign Investors
paras: 台積電 (2330-TW)(TSM-US) 今 (11) 日召開董事會，共拍板四大議案，包括通過第二季財報、核准配發第二季現金股利 7 元、核准資本支出 294 億美元以及與索尼合資成立新公司，其中，第二季現金股利維持 7 元，預計 2026 年 12 月 10 日除息，並於 2027 年 1 月 7 日發放，值得注意的是台積電本次股利發放開始提供外資股東美元股利的選擇。
台積電今日核准 2026 年第二季營業報告書及財務報表，其中第二季合併營收約新台幣 1 兆 2,703 億 8 千萬元，稅後純益約新台幣 7,065 億 6 千萬元，每股盈餘為新台幣 27.25 元。
台積電此次核准配發 2026 年第二季之每股現金股利 7 元，其普通股配息基準日訂定為 2026 年 12 月 16 日，除息交易日則為 2026 年 12 月 10 日。依公司法第一六五條規定，在公司決定分派股息之基準日前五日內，亦即自 2026 年 12 月 12 日起至 12 月 16 日止，停止普通股股票過戶，並於 2027 年 1 月 7 日發放。
此外，因應台灣金管會法規修訂，台積電將自本次股利分派開始提供依「華僑及外國人投資證券管理辦法」投資之外資股東以美元收受現金股利之選擇權利。台積公司在美國紐約證券交易所上市之美國存託憑證之除息交易日及配息基準日皆為 2026 年 12 月 10 日。
台積電為因應基於市場需求預測及技術開發藍圖所制定的長期產能規劃，核准資本預算約美金 294 億 4,250 萬元，內容主要包括建置及升級先進製程產能、建置及升級先進封裝、成熟及 / 或特殊製程產能、廠房興建及廠務設施工程。
台積電此次也核准與索尼半導體解決方案公司 (Sony Semiconductor Solutions Corporation) 合資成立新公司，以研發與製造下一世代影像感測器，以及於不超過 2,820 億日元之額度內認購該合資公司之股份。
paras_en: TSMC (2330-TW)(TSM-US) held a board meeting today, approving four major proposals, including the approval of the second-quarter financial report, the approval of NT$7 per share cash dividend for the second quarter, the approval of capital expenditures of US$29.4 billion, and the establishment of a new company in partnership with Sony. The NT$7 per share cash dividend for the second quarter is expected to be paid on December 10, 2026, and the dividend will be distributed on January 7, 2027. Notably, TSMC will provide foreign shareholders with the option to receive US dollar dividends for the first time.

TSMC approved its 2026 second-quarter operating report and financial statements, with second-quarter consolidated revenue of approximately NT$1.2703 trillion and net income of approximately NT$706.6 billion. Earnings per share were NT$27.25.

TSMC has approved the distribution of NT$7 per share cash dividend for the second quarter, with the record date set for December 16, 2026, and the ex-dividend date set for December 10, 2026. In accordance with Article 165 of the Company Law, the ordinary shares will be suspended from transfer from December 12 to December 16, 2026, and the dividend will be distributed on January 7, 2027.

In addition, in response to the revision of the regulations by the Financial Supervisory Commission, TSMC will provide foreign shareholders with the option to receive US dollar dividends for the first time, starting from this dividend distribution. The ex-dividend date and record date for the American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) listed on the New York Stock Exchange are both December 10, 2026.

TSMC has approved a capital budget of approximately US$29.4 billion, which includes the construction and upgrading of advanced process capacity, the construction and upgrading of advanced packaging, mature and/or special process capacity, and the construction of factory buildings and factory facilities.

TSMC has also approved the establishment of a new company in partnership with Sony Semiconductor Solutions Corporation to develop and manufacture next-generation image sensors, and to purchase shares of the joint venture company within a limit of approximately JPY2.82 trillion.

items.title: 輝達募5000億美元AI資金是「循環融資」？大摩反駁：看好「近100%毛利」新財源
paras: 針對輝達 (NVDA-US) 宣布帶動最多 5,000 億美元的外部資本投入，積極擴大人工智慧（AI）基礎建設布局，摩根士丹利 (MS-US) 分析指出，這項資本運作模式不僅有助於消除市場對 AI 產業「循環融資」的疑慮，也可能讓輝達藉由後續收益分成，開拓高毛利且可持續的長期收入管道。
為支持全球 AI 工廠的建設需求，輝達週一（10 日）宣布攜手六家機構夥伴，籌組一個潛在規模達 5,000 億美元的「獨立算力融資平台」。
摩根士丹利對此認為，這項結構性安排不僅有效緩解外界疑慮，更為輝達開闢出一條毛利率近乎 100% 的長期經常性收入來源。
該行分析，這筆 5,000 億美元資金並非已經拍板的投資承諾，而是由六家合作機構各自依照獨立判斷，評估是否投入個別專案，目前尚無具體投資案完成落地。
值得注意的是，輝達在整個架構中刻意退居次要角色。官方將自身定位為「生態系統支持方」，僅提供一項上限為單筆投資 25% 的「殘值支持機制」，並強調這是「有限度、以剩餘價值為基礎的補充性支持，而非取代獨立承銷」。
摩根士丹利指出，這種安排的用意十分明確，即把主導決策權交給專業第三方機構，等於在制度設計上斬斷了「輝達貸款給客戶、客戶再拿錢買回輝達晶片」這種自我循環邏輯的成立空間。
輝達執行長黃仁勳稍早也在社群平台上證實，這項機制正是針對外界的循環融資質疑而設計。

摩根士丹利：外界對信用風險的疑慮被誇大

針對市場流傳已久的循環融資疑雲，摩根士丹利在報告中也做了一番梳理。
報告顯示，輝達目前實際承擔的直接信用敞口其實相當有限，主要集中在替少數規模較小的新興雲端服務商提供租賃擔保，依輝達最新申報文件，相關總曝險約為 35 億美元。
至於外界關注的股權投資部分，摩根士丹利強調這些屬於權益性質的投資，並非贈款或信用擔保；公開市場部位表現整體良好，私有公司投資雖然較難精確估值，但性質上仍屬股權資產，與外界渲染的「表外風險」不能混為一談。
摩根士丹利並提到，部分媒體報導引用的是尚未發生、且規劃在未來十年逐步展開的大型信貸安排，實際上放大了風險印象。

從賣硬體到收租金：近 100% 毛利的新財源

這次融資結構真正吸引摩根士丹利關注的，是它與輝達既有收入分成計畫的緊密結合。
輝達新聞稿提到，新平台將實現「長期使用量掛鉤收入」，代表相關投資項目未來會被納入輝達已對外揭露的分潤框架之中。
摩根士丹利進一步估算，在輝達可從 GPU 使用收益中抽取 35% 的盈餘分成、GPU 租賃價格維持每小時 13 美元，且全球每年新增 5GW 算力的假設下，輝達每年潛在新增營收可達約 510 億美元，並有望推升 2029 會計年度每股盈餘（EPS）約 9.83%。
這類收入的特別之處在於，輝達無需承擔硬體折舊與營運成本即可入帳，毛利率因此逼近 100%，且具備可持續、可重複的特性，性質上更接近軟體訂閱或雲端服務的年金型收入。
摩根士丹利認為，這標誌著輝達正從「硬體銷售商」蛻變為「AI 基礎設施生態系統的營運者」。

風險猶存：去槓桿疑慮未完全消除

儘管整體評價正面，摩根士丹利也提醒幾項不容忽視的變數。
首先是資金能否如期到位。該行指出，5,000 億美元終究只是名目上的潛在規模，各合作夥伴依專案各自評估，並無強制部署的約束機制，實際落地金額存在相當大的不確定性。
其次，輝達仍非完全置身於信用風險之外。即使參與上限訂在 25%，部分專案中輝達依然要承擔信用曝險。
摩根士丹利表示，相較於單純的信用擔保，更傾向輝達以 GPU 使用權方式提供支持，因為這類 GPU 本來就能用於輝達自家開源模型的開發需求，實質成本更低。
第三個隱憂則是整體 AI 生態系統的槓桿水位持續墊高。即便輝達自身未直接加槓桿，隨著主權基金與新興雲端服務商大舉投入，產業整體負債仍在攀升。
摩根士丹利也點出，部分大型雲端服務商目前現金流已呈現中性甚至負值，市場對 AI 生態能否撐住持續加槓桿的態勢，看法仍存分歧。

估值吸引力仍在，摩根士丹利維持半導體首選

綜合評估後，摩根士丹利認為此次融資結構帶來的正面效益明顯大於潛在風險，因此維持輝達「超配」評等，目標價 288 美元不變，並將輝達列為半導體類股首選。
摩根士丹利並預估，輝達 2026 會計年度營收將年增 82%，2027 會計年度再成長 52.4%，對應每股盈餘分別為 4.77 美元與 8.98 美元。
基於該行的 ModelWare 框架，2027 會計年度每股盈餘預測 8.96 美元，對應當前股價本益比約 24 倍，低於超微半導體 (AMD-US) 、博通 (AVGO-US) 等同類算力半導體公司，估值具備相對吸引力。
摩根士丹利同時指出，輝達 Blackwell 系列產品目前仍是生成式 AI 工作負載的主流選擇，算力需求持續供不應求；下一代 Rubin 架構問世後，可望延續其效能領先優勢，產品週期對估值的支撐邏輯依然成立。

items.title: 台積電囤10億美元蘋果晶片？郭明錤駁斥：庫存上升是量產爬坡初期正常現象
items.title_en: TSMC Denies $10 Billion Apple Chip Inventory: "It's Normal for Production to Ramp Up"
paras: 儘管記憶體缺貨風暴持續衝擊蘋果 (AAPL-US) 硬體出貨規劃，但關於市場近期流傳「台積電 (2330-TW) 手上囤積價值十億美元蘋果處理器半成品」一說，卻遭到知名蘋果供應鏈分析師郭明錤公開駁斥。
郭明錤週二（11 日）在社群平台 X 發文表示，蘋果今年確實因記憶體供給短缺而調降部分硬體出貨計畫，但這與外界所稱的「供應鏈端被動囤貨」是兩回事。
他解釋稱，蘋果向來會提前至少三個月，依據預估可取得的記憶體數量，來安排台積電端的處理器生產步調，而非要求台積電先大量趕工製造半成品晶圓。
郭明錤強調，就其掌握的產業資訊而言，並未發現台積電先囤積十億美元等級的處理器半成品、再等待記憶體供應的情況。
他形容，蘋果與台積電都是全球供應鏈執行力數一數二的企業，雙方長年維持高度緊密的協同運作，出現如此規模的半成品被動堆積「並不尋常」。
這波傳言的源頭，來自台積電第二季財報揭露的庫存數據。
財報顯示，台積電庫存周轉天數來到 87 天，較首季的 80 天、去年同期的 76 天皆明顯拉長；同一季度，2 奈米製程貢獻的晶圓銷售收入占比約 3%。
部分消息人士據此推測，台積電為衝刺蘋果採 2 奈米製程的 A20 Pro 處理器產能全力趕工，卻因 DRAM 缺貨，導致價值十億美元的晶圓卡在半成品階段，得等記憶體到貨才能完成最終封裝。
獨立科技記者 Tim Culpan 此前也曾撰文指出，台積電 2 奈米製程良率與產能都無虞，真正的 iPhone 出貨瓶頸在 DRAM 供給。
針對上述推論，郭明錤提出三項質疑。
首先，台積電每逢新一代先進製程進入量產爬坡初期，庫存天數本就容易走高，3 奈米、5 奈米世代都曾出現同樣狀況，並非 2 奈米獨有的異常訊號。
其次，台積電財報所稱的「庫存」定義範圍甚廣，涵蓋在製品、製成品、原物料及備品等多項目，處理器半成品只是其中一部分，不能直接把整體庫存增幅簡化等同於處理器堆積。
第三，今年採用台積電 2 奈米製程的客戶並非只有蘋果，超微半導體 (AMD-US) 、聯發科 (2454-TW) 等晶片設計廠商同樣下單此製程，其備貨需求也會反映在台積電整體庫存水位中，不宜全數歸因於蘋果單一客戶。
郭明錤進一步從供應鏈邏輯分析，若目前瓶頸並不在台積電端，提前大量生產半成品對蘋果並無實質好處，蘋果也沒有理由為此額外付費。
他也補充，這不代表台積電從未提前備妥在製品庫存，但依現行雙方協作機制，出現大規模被動囤積的機率極低。

蘋果高層已證實供應壓力存在

儘管「十億美元積壓」的具體說法遭到質疑，蘋果高層卻已在財報會議上承認公司確實面臨供應端壓力。
蘋果對第四財季（自然季）的營收指引為年增 9% 至 11%，低於分析師先前預期的約 12.1%，公司將匯率波動與供應限制列為兩大主要拖累因素。
蘋果財務長 Kevan Parekh 表示，受供應限制影響，iPhone、Mac 與 iPad 三大產品線的成長動能都將受衝擊，相關業務增速將落在約 15% 的雙位數區間；若扣除約 2.5% 的匯率影響，服務業務成長率預估將與第三財季 12% 的水準大致持平。
執行長庫克則將問題癥結歸咎於先進製程系統單晶片（SoC）產能不足，並指出這主要源於需求預測失準，而非常規性的供應瓶頸。
他表示，iPhone 與 Mac 的實際銷售表現都明顯優於公司原先預期，「我們一直在提前拉動供應，但到了某個階段，這終究是有極限的。」
值得留意的是，為緩解記憶體荒，外界傳出蘋果近期已開始測試採用中國記憶體廠長鑫科技 (688825-CN) 的晶片，目標鎖定在中國市場銷售的部分 iPhone 與 MacBook 機種，雙方據稱已展開初步接觸洽談。
paras_en: Despite the ongoing memory shortage impacting Apple's (AAPL-US) hardware shipments, a rumor that TSMC (2330-TW) has $10 billion worth of Apple processor semi-finished products in inventory has been denied by renowned Apple supply chain analyst Ming-Chi Kuo.

Kuo posted on social media platform X on Tuesday (11th) that Apple did indeed reduce its hardware shipment plans this year due to memory supply shortages, but this is different from the "passive inventory buildup" claimed by the market.

He explained that Apple has always arranged TSMC's processor production schedules at least three months in advance, based on estimated memory availability, rather than asking TSMC to mass-produce semi-finished wafers in advance.
Kuo emphasized that, based on his industry information, he has not found any evidence of TSMC stockpiling $10 billion worth of processor semi-finished products, waiting for memory supply.
He described Apple and TSMC as two of the world's top supply chain execution companies, with a long history of tight collaboration, and that such a large-scale passive inventory buildup is "unusual".
The origin of this rumor comes from TSMC's second-quarter earnings report, which revealed a significant increase in inventory turnover days.

The report showed that TSMC's inventory turnover days increased to 87 days, surpassing the 80 days of the first quarter and 76 days of the same period last year; during the same quarter, 2-nanometer process contributed about 3% to wafer sales revenue.

Some sources speculated that TSMC was working overtime to boost production of Apple's A20 Pro processor using the 2-nanometer process, but due to DRAM shortages, the company was left with $10 billion worth of semi-finished wafers, waiting for memory to arrive before completing final packaging.
Independent tech journalist Tim Culpan previously wrote that TSMC's 2-nanometer process yield and capacity were not a concern, and that the real iPhone shipment bottleneck was DRAM supply.
In response to the above speculation, Kuo raised three questions.
Firstly, TSMC's inventory turnover days tend to increase during the initial ramp-up phase of new process generations, and this is not unique to the 2-nanometer process.

Secondly, TSMC's reported inventory includes a wide range of items, including products, components, raw materials, and spare parts, so it's not accurate to directly attribute the overall inventory increase to processor stockpiling.

Thirdly, not all customers using TSMC's 2-nanometer process are Apple, and other chip design companies like AMD (AMD-US) and MediaTek (2454-TW) also ordered this process, which would affect TSMC's overall inventory levels.

Kuo further analyzed the supply chain logic, pointing out that if the current bottleneck is not at TSMC, then producing large quantities of semi-finished products in advance would not benefit Apple, and Apple would not pay extra for this.

He also added that this does not mean TSMC has never prepared inventory in advance, but based on the current collaboration mechanism, the probability of large-scale passive inventory buildup is extremely low.
Apple's top executives have confirmed that supply pressure exists.
Although the specific claim of $10 billion in inventory has been disputed, Apple's top executives have acknowledged that the company is indeed facing supply-side pressure.

Apple's CFO Kevan Parekh stated that due to supply constraints, the growth momentum of the iPhone, Mac, and iPad product lines would be impacted, with related business growth rates expected to be in the mid-teens; excluding the approximately 2.5% impact of currency fluctuations, service business growth rates are expected to be similar to the 12% level of the third quarter.
CEO Cook attributed the problem to insufficient SoC production capacity, primarily due to inaccurate demand forecasting and irregular supply bottlenecks.
He said that iPhone and Mac sales have been significantly better than expected, "We have been pushing supply ahead, but at some point, there is a limit to this."

It's worth noting that Apple has recently begun testing the use of memory chips from Chinese memory manufacturer Longxiang Technology (688825-CN) for some iPhone and MacBook models sold in the Chinese market, with both parties reportedly engaging in initial discussions.

items.title: 如期推出！蘋果全新玻璃設計iPhone計畫保持不變 預計明年20週年當天首次亮相
items.title_en: Apple's New Glass Design iPhone Plan Remains Unchanged, Expected to Debut Next Year on 20th Anniversary
paras: 外媒引述知情人士最新報導指出，蘋果並未取消「20 週年玻璃 iPhone」計畫，反將在 2027 年推出以玻璃材質為核心演進的 iPhone Pro 機型，內部代號 V73、V74，正面與背面採玻璃、以曲面延伸至側邊、中段保留金屬框，否定 Jefferies 分析師 Edison Lee 本週出具報告稱蘋果「計畫喊停、下調評級」的說法。
知情人士向《彭博資訊》指出，蘋果設計團隊早年曾構想更激進的「全玻璃無縫機身」，用玻璃取代金屬中框，但在解決多片玻璃可靠接合與量產良率上卡關，早期即被捨棄，現行方案是妥協後的演進版，也就是保留金屬圈支撐結構強度，玻璃涵蓋面與曲率放大，視覺連續性逼近「一塊玻璃裹住手機」。
知情人士透露，新機設計約提前一年定型，2027 年機種已進入後期驗證，若無不可預見問題不會再大改。
iPhone 貢獻蘋果近半營收，上季銷售增 22% 領跑各部門，公司亟需用外觀大改延續換機週期。
蘋果下月秋季新品發表會料將先見到折疊 iPhone，為史上最大單項外觀變革、iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max 與攝像頭重構，並新增「深紅色」配色。
蘋果創辦人賈伯斯 2007 年初代 iPhone 以玻璃 + 金屬開拓觸控時代，20 週年這一役，蘋果選擇不冒全玻璃量產險，而是把「玻璃感」推到曲面側邊與前後連續過渡，兼顧旗艦辨識度與可製造性。
蘋果發言人拒絕對上述報導置評，但路線圖未動的說法，已讓供應鏈回補玻璃熱彎、UTG 超薄玻璃與金屬中框精密加工訂單預期。
paras_en: Sources close to the matter have revealed that Apple has not canceled its plan for a 20th-anniversary glass iPhone, but instead plans to release an iPhone Pro model with a glass core in 2027, codenamed V73 and V74. The new device will feature a glass front and back, with a curved design extending to the sides, and a metal frame in the middle.

According to sources, Apple's design team had initially considered a more radical 'all-glass seamless body' design, where glass would replace the metal midframe. However, they encountered issues with reliable bonding and production yields, and the idea was scrapped early on. The current design is an evolution of this concept, retaining a metal frame for structural integrity and using glass with increased curvature to create a seamless visual effect.

Sources have revealed that the new iPhone design has been finalized about a year ahead of schedule, and the 2027 model is now in the final testing phase. Unless unforeseen issues arise, there will be no major changes to the design.
The iPhone contributes to over half of Apple's revenue, with sales increasing by 22% in the previous quarter. The company needs to refresh the design to maintain the upgrade cycle.

Apple's upcoming autumn product launch event is expected to feature a foldable iPhone, which will be the largest single design change in iPhone history. The iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max will also feature a redesigned camera and a new 'deep red' color option.

Apple co-founder Steve Jobs introduced the first iPhone with a glass and metal design in 2007, marking the beginning of the touchscreen era. For its 20th anniversary, Apple has chosen not to take the risk of mass-producing all-glass devices, but instead has opted to bring 'glass feel' to the curved sides and front and back of the device, balancing flagship recognition with manufacturability.
Apple has declined to comment on the report, but the unchanged roadmap has led to a surge in orders for glass, UTG (Ultra-Thin Glass), and metal midframe components from the supply chain.

items.title: 〈美股早盤〉美伊和平露曙光 主要指數漲跌互現、美債殖利率下滑
paras: 美股主要指數周二 (11 日) 漲跌互現，市場傳出美國與伊朗接近達成某種安排，有望結束長達六個月的衝突並推動荷姆茲海峽恢復通行，帶動油價回落及美債殖利率下滑。
標普 500 指數與那斯達克指數在輝達等晶片股走強下上揚；美國原油一度跌破每桶 82 美元，緩解能源價格可能推升通膨的疑慮。不過，投資人對美伊能否達成更全面的協議仍保持審慎，並等待周三 (12 日) 公布的消費者物價指數(CPI)。
截稿前，道瓊工業指數漲逾 160 點或近 0.3%，那斯達克綜合指數跌近 60 點或 近 0.2%，標普 500 指數漲 0.02%，費城半導體指數漲 1.0%。台積電 ADR 漲近 0.4%。
美股指數期貨周二小幅走高，美債收復稍早跌幅，主因市場重新燃起美國與伊朗可能達成協議的希望，帶動國際油價回吐大部分漲幅。
截稿前，標普 500 指數期貨上漲 0.2%，那斯達克 100 指數期貨上漲 0.4%；美國 10 年期公債殖利率下滑 1 個基點至 4.69%。布蘭特原油一度明顯走高，隨後漲幅收斂至 0.4%，報每桶約 88 美元。
巴基斯坦國防部長表示，近日釋出的訊號顯示，美國與伊朗已「接近達成某種安排」，提振市場風險偏好。此前，美國總統川普向伊朗提出一系列廣泛的新要求，一度降低外界對雙方達成協議及重新開放荷姆茲海峽的期待。
Partners Group 首席投資策略師 Anastasia Amoroso 表示，投資人必須接受目前無法確定和平協議何時達成，甚至是否會達成的現實，因此應把焦點重新放在真正推動經濟的基本面，也就是企業獲利，而今年企業獲利表現相當亮眼。
除了中東局勢，市場也將關注美國周三 (12 日) 公布的 7 月消費者物價指數(CPI)，尋找 Fed 利率路徑的新線索。上周五公布的經濟數據弱於預期，已降低市場對 Fed 立即升息的押注。《彭博》調查經濟學家的預估中值顯示，7 月 CPI 可能較前月上升 0.1%，扭轉 6 月下降 0.4% 的走勢。
克里夫蘭聯準銀行總裁哈瑪克 (Beth Hammack) 周一仍釋出鷹派訊號，表示 Fed 可能需要多次升息，才能把通膨拉回 2% 目標。
另一方面，大型科技公司的支出熱潮仍有望延續。英特爾 (INTC-US) 將增資規模擴大至 200 億美元，市場認購需求超過 1,000 億美元。此前，輝達 (NVDA-US) 也計劃向多家華爾街金融機構尋求合計 5,000 億美元的融資承諾。
盤前個股方面，Riot Platforms(RIOT-US) 上漲 16%，Anthropic 與這家比特幣挖礦業者簽署價值 91 億美元的資料中心協議；發電設備製造商 Babcock & Wilcox Enterprises(BW-US) 第二季營收遠優於分析師平均預期，激勵股價大漲 36%。
《彭博行業研究》資料顯示，標普 500 成分股第二季獲利可望年增約 32%，延續第一季成長 30% 的強勁表現，未來兩季增幅也預估超過 20%。美國銀行策略師指出，自 1936 年以來，如此強勁且持續的獲利成長僅出現過 10 次。
